**Code at HEAD is one step** (name + sports, then Finish), mirroring the web's `coach.onboarding.tsx`; the PRD row's "levels and hours per week per sport → invite code share" and club join are not in the app's onboarding (levels are saved at their suggested hours; club join lives in Settings, §7.12; the invite card lives in the roster's Add-an-athlete hub, §7.2).
- **Load:** `GET /coach/profile` (creates the coach row on first sight) → names, sports from levels, primary cap (`CoachSports.maxPrimarySports(effectiveTier, foundingCoach, distinctPrimarySportCount)`; null = unlimited). Then, best effort and in order: `POST /me/terms/accept`; apply a stashed promo (`POST /me/promo-code`; notice "Promo code {CODE} applied."); file a stashed requested sport (`POST /sport-requests`, source `coach_signup`): on a retryable failure (offline, 429, 5xx, cancelled) move it to `UnsentSportRequest(userId, sport)` (DataStore `gradus.onboarding.unsentSportRequest`), sent on this coach's next `/me`; a 4xx drops it. Then **auto-finish**: a stash with names and a primary sport, a profile not yet onboarded, and no sports yet → fill name and sports = primary + every always-secondary sport, show progress "Finishing your setup…" (`onboarding.autoFinishing`), run Finish. A failure leaves the prefilled form with the error.
- **States:** loading with no profile → "Setting up your coach profile…"; load failure with no profile → "Couldn't load your coach profile" + message + "Try again".
- **Form:** no eyebrow (`ad1e9bf`); title "Tell us about yourself"; first/last name (`onboarding.firstName`, `onboarding.lastName`); "Which sports do you coach?" multi-select chips, Strength & Conditioning first, chips over the cap disabled at 45% with TalkBack "…, not available on your plan" (`onboarding.sport.{key}`); cap message "Your plan includes {n} primary sport(s). Strength & Conditioning is always available." (`onboarding.capMessage`); legacy custom sports as removable accent pills (TalkBack "Remove {label}"); Request a sport (filed now, source `coach_onboarding`; a listed name selects it within the cap, else "{label} is already listed. {cap message}"); error line; **Finish** / "Saving…" (`onboarding.finish`) enabled with both names, at least one sport, and ready. Notices below as check-icon lines. Top bar **Sign out** (`onboarding.signOut`).
- **Finish order (the web's `handleFinish`):** `PUT /coach/profile {firstName, lastName}` → `PUT /coach/levels` (every catalog level of each sport at its suggested hours; custom sports one general level) → `POST /coach/onboarding/complete` with an `Idempotency-Key` derived from one per-attempt nonce (kept across retries) → claim the stashed invite: `POST /invites/parent/claim`, on failure `POST /invites/adult-athlete/claim` (each with its own derived key); notices/toasts "Linked to the parent's account (N athlete[s])." + toast "Linked to the parent's account", "Linked to the athlete's account." + toast "Linked to the athlete's account", or "Couldn't link the invite: {message}" (error toast; not fatal) → clear the stash → reload the profile → success haptic → if `PlanGate.needsPlanSetup` (paywall on, Founding window closed, entitlement does not unlock the coach area) show PlanStatus, then refresh `/me`.
- Tests: port `finishSequence`, `claimFallback`, `requestSport`, `pendingRequestFiled`, `pendingRequestFailure`, `requestListedAtCap`, `saveFailure`, `coachAutoFinish`, `coachFormWithoutSetup`, `coachSetupRoundTrip`.

#### 7.1.11 Parent onboarding after the account (iOS `ParentOnboardingView/Model.swift`; PRD §7.1 "Parent sign-up")

Steps `Loading → Profiles → Verify? → Goals(i) → Schedule(i) → Done`; resumes from `GET /signup/parent/status`. Top bar **Sign out**.
- **Load:** status has a parent profile and athletes → finish (the web would let them in). Prefill the coach code from the stash or `status.inviteCode`. A complete pre-account stash, no athletes yet, and no partial code → submit Profiles silently (still showing "Loading…") and land on Goals or Verify; a failure shows the prefilled Profiles form with the error.
- **Profiles:** eyebrow "Parent setup"; with a found coach: title "Coach {full name}", "You're connecting to this coach.", sport chips; otherwise "Create your profiles" / "Add yourself and each athlete in your family." Card "You": names (`parent.firstName`, `parent.lastName`), "Coach invite code (optional)" ("From your coach"; normalized as typed; `parent.coachCode`) with a live preview (`POST /signup/parent/coach-preview`, cancelled on change): "Looking up your coach…" or the error; "Promo code (optional)" (`parent.promo`). Card "Your athletes": as in §7.1.7b, plus **`DirectNotice(athleteName, consentAct = true)`** ("your athletes" with 2+, else the first name or "your athlete"). Error line; **Continue** (enabled with names, a complete athlete, no partial code). Errors: "That coach invite code is too short. Check it, or leave it blank."; "Add at least one athlete with name and birthdate."
- **Submit order:** `POST /signup/parent/start {firstName, lastName, code?}` → `POST /me/terms/accept` (ignore errors) → if the verification repository reports `isNeeded`, hold `(code, athletes)` and go to **Verify** (§7.1.12, named for the first athlete) → else `POST /signup/parent/link-coach` (athletes; `Idempotency-Key` derived from the code and each athlete's "first|last|birthdate"); a 403 `parent_unverified` here also opens Verify → promo (`POST /me/promo-code`, notice "Promo code {CODE} applied.") → clear the stashed invite → `POST /signup/parent/athletes-for-code` → Goals(0), or Done if no athletes.
- **Verify:** the step in wizard layout; when verified (webhook, `/verified`, or the switch off) link the held athletes and continue; a link failure stays on Verify with the error and a **Continue** that retries.
- **Goals(i):** progress "Athlete {i+1} of {n}" with pips; title "{First}'s goals"; "Where {First} is now, and where you'd like them to go."; GoalsForm (§7.1.18) with the roster's sports; **"Save & next"** or, on the last, **"Continue"** (enabled when complete) → `POST /signup/parent/goals` (long-term goal trimmed). Incomplete: "Pick a sport, a level, and a target."
- **Schedule(i):** "Athlete {i+1} of {n}"; title "{First}'s lessons"; "When does {First} have lessons with this coach? You can add this later."; ScheduleEditor; **"Save & next"** / **"Finish"** and **"Skip"** (saves an empty list) → `POST /signup/parent/schedule`. Validation messages from `LessonScheduleRules`: "End time must be after start time for every slot."; "Pick which week of the month for every monthly lesson."; "Pick 2 weeks of the month for every 2x-monthly lesson."; "Pick a starting date for every every-other-week lesson."
- **Done:** "Finishing up…", clear the stash, success haptic, refresh `/me` (gate clears when athletes exist).
- **Process death:** the stash plus server status resume it at the same step (QA §1 "kill the app mid-flow and reopen → resumes at the same step"); the held athletes during Verify are re-derived from the stash on restart (Android addition: iOS keeps them in memory only; a restart on iOS returns to Profiles with the stash and re-submits, which reaches Verify again — Android must behave the same and must not create the athletes twice, which the idempotency key guarantees).
- Tests: port `profiles`, `guards`, `scheduleRules`, `parentAutoSubmit`, and `ParentVerificationTests.verifyBetweenProfileAndAthletes`, `refusalOpensStep`, `noStepWhenNotNeeded`.

#### 7.1.12 "Verify you're an adult" (iOS `ParentVerificationStep.swift`; §6.13 A1–A2; #29, #34, #38)

One component, three hosts: parent onboarding (wizard layout: eyebrow "Parent setup", title "Verify you're an adult", card), guardian claim and Settings opt-in (compact card with a shield icon and the bold heading "Verify you're an adult").
- **Explanation:** optional (Settings opt-in while the switch is off): "Soon, every parent of an athlete under 18 confirms once that they're an adult before connecting a coach or opening a conversation. You can do it now so nothing pauses later. Our partner Kids Web Services runs a quick check; Gradus sees only the result." Required, with a name: "Before you can connect a coach to {name} or open their conversations, we confirm once that you're an adult." Without: "Before you can connect a coach or open a conversation for an athlete under 18, we confirm once that you're an adult." Both required forms continue: " Our partner Kids Web Services does the check with a payment card or the last four digits of your Social Security number, on its own secure page. Gradus never sees those details, only the result." Nothing anywhere says "card check" (#38).
- **States:** loading (progress, TalkBack "Checking your verification"); KWS not configured (`available == false`): "Verification isn't switched on for this environment yet. Please try again later." in `attentionInk`; waiting (`sentFromHere || requestedAt != null`): "Check your email for the verification link. This screen updates on its own the moment you finish." + outlined **"Resend the link"** showing "Resend in {n}s" during the 60 s cooldown (TalkBack label stays "Resend the link", value "Available in {n} seconds"); otherwise primary **"Email me the verification link"** ("Sending…"). Tags `parentVerification`, `.unavailable`, `.waiting`, `.resend`, `.send`.
  - **Initial load failure** (`refresh(initial:)` sets `failed(message)`): error line with the API's user message (TalkBack "Error: {message}", announced) above a **disabled** "Email me the verification link" (`canSend` needs `isAvailable`, false with no status); no Retry button; the next `ON_RESUME` or `VerificationSignals` bump retries (code parity).
  - **Null status (no parent profile yet):** finishes at once when not optional; the Settings opt-in (optional) keeps showing the card.
  - Polling starts only while waiting. Both "Email me the verification link" and "Resend the link" are enabled only when `canSend` (available, not busy, cooldown 0, not done).
- **Send:** `POST /guardian/verification/start`: `email_sent` → waiting, start the 60 s cooldown (stored as an end time so it survives leaving and returning), announce the waiting message, refresh; `already_verified` → refresh; `not_configured` → "Verification isn't switched on yet. Please try again later or contact support."; `rate_limited` → "Too many attempts. Give it an hour, then send the link again."
- **Done rule:** verified, or (not optional and `required == false`), or no parent profile yet (not optional) → `isDone`, announce "Verified. Thanks." when verified, run `onVerified` once, then `isFinished`.
- **Refresh triggers:** every 5 s while waiting (a coroutine tied to the composable's lifecycle; stops on leave, resumes on return); `Lifecycle.Event.ON_RESUME`; `VerificationSignals.completions` change (a `/verified` link handled by the shell).
- Tests: port all `ParentVerificationTests` (send/wait/done; cooldown survives deactivate; done at once; not-configured and rate-limited messages; signal refresh).

#### 7.1.13 Self-managed athlete onboarding (iOS `AdultOnboardingView/Model.swift`)

Steps `Loading → Profile → Coach → Goals(i) → Schedule(i) → Done`. Top bar **Sign out**.
- **Load:** first `ageSignals.requestIfNeeded()` and capture the band. `GET /adult-athlete/onboarding`: a parent-managed athlete row → finish. No row + a complete stash + a submittable profile → submit silently and land on Coach. Otherwise Profile (no row) or Coach (row exists).
- **Profile** (eyebrow "Athlete setup", "Tell us about yourself"): Birthdate (hidden when the band is under 13); under 13 (typed or band) → the parent-only card in signed-in form (no code button); 18+ on an under-18 band → the contradiction message (announced); otherwise names (`adult.firstName`, `adult.lastName`), for 13–17 the guardian email (`adult.guardianEmail`) and the provisional note; **Continue** → `POST /signup/adult-athlete {firstName, lastName, birthdate, guardianEmail?}` (per-attempt idempotency key) → `POST /me/terms/accept` (ignore errors) → promo → Coach. A server 422 `parent_required` or other refusal shows verbatim.
- **Coach** (eyebrow "Your coach", title "Connect a coach", "Have a coach's invite code? Add it now, or skip and add one later from Settings."): "Coach invite code" ("ABCD2345"; `adult.coachCode`; prefilled from the stash) with live preview (`POST /adult-athlete/coach/preview`): "Looking up your coach…", error, or "Coach {name}" + "Which sports will you work on together?" + toggle chips (`adult.sport.{key}`; a single sport pre-selects). For a minor: "Your account is waiting for your parent or guardian to confirm it. A coach can be connected after that; skip this step for now." (`adult.provisionalNote`, `attentionInk`). **"Connect"** (enabled with a found coach and ≥1 sport) → `POST /adult-athlete/coach/link {code, sports}` (idempotency key) → notice "Connected to {coach}." → Goals for the selected sports; **"Skip for now"** → Goals over the whole catalog.
- **Goals(i):** progress "Sport {i+1} of {n}" (or "Your goals"); title "Your goals"; "Where you are now, and where you'd like to go."; GoalsForm; "Save & next"/"Continue" → `PUT /adult-athlete/goals`.
- **Schedule(i):** `GET /adult-athlete/coaches`; none → Done. "Coach {i+1} of {n}"; title "Lessons with {coach}"; "When do you have lessons? You can add this later."; ScheduleEditor; "Save & next"/"Finish" and "Skip" → `PUT /adult-athlete/schedules/{coachId}`.
- **Done:** "Finishing up…", clear the stash, haptic, refresh `/me`.
- Athlete Settings (§7.12) shows, for `provisional`, eyebrow "Waiting for your parent" with "Your goals and plans are yours now. Connecting a coach and messaging open once a parent or guardian confirms your account from the email we sent them. Accounts nobody confirms are removed after three months." (`athleteProfile.provisional`). Code at HEAD wins (A2): this card has **no resend action** (the iOS PRD §7.1 row says "with resend"; `AthleteProfileView` shows only the eyebrow and text); do not add one.
- Tests: port `AdultOnboarding` `happyPath`, `minorAndSkip`, `adultAutoSubmit`, `AthleteEntryTests` (5) and `AgeSignalEntryTests.signedInOnboarding`.

(destructive) / "3–24 lowercase letters, numbers, or underscores."; "Password" ("At least 8 characters"; `athlete.password`); "Promo code (optional)"; **"Create account"** (enabled: valid username, 8+ password, not taken).

#### 7.1.15 Invite entry and invite links (iOS `InviteEntryView/Model.swift`, `AppModel.openInvite`)

- **Screen** (no top-bar title): title "Invite code". **No explainer line and no visible field label**: the page title names the field. The field's TalkBack label is "Invite code", and its explanation moves into the `onClick` action label "8 letters and numbers, or paste a gradus.training/i link." (iOS accessibility hint; handoff §7 "The explanation lives in VoiceOver"). The field shows the format as its placeholder (mono title size, "ABCD2345", Ascii keyboard, all caps, no autocorrect, IME Go; `invite.code`; focused when empty); as typed: uppercase, keep only the 34 characters `ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ23456789` (0 and 1 are dropped; **O and I are allowed**, exactly as `GradusCore/Onboarding/OnboardingModels.swift` `InviteCodeText.normalize`), cap at 8 — applied by writing the normalized value back on every change so a ninth keystroke never shows (iOS beta 2026-10-07 bug). Pasting (`InviteCodeText.extract`): trim whitespace; if it parses as a URL whose path has an `i` segment followed by another segment, that next segment normalized is the code and must be complete (8 characters), else nothing; otherwise a bare string of exactly 8 allowed characters in any case is accepted (uppercased); anything else is ignored. Error line; **Continue** (`invite.continue`) → `POST /invites/resolve`. A code arriving from a link resolves on appear. Editing the code while a resolve runs or after an outcome clears the outcome and the error (`model.clear()` on change).
- **One shared normalizer.** Kotlin `InviteCodeText` in `:core:data` (`onboarding` package) (`LENGTH = 8`, `normalize`, `isComplete`, `extract`) is used by **every** invite-code field: this screen, the athlete claim code (§7.1.14), the parent coach code (§7.1.11), the adult-athlete coach code (§7.1.13) and `InviteCodeEntryCard` (§7.1.17). (Club join codes are a different alphabet, `A–Z0–9`, `JoinClubModel`; §7.12 owns them.)
- **Outcomes:** parent's or adult athlete's code → coach setup with the code; coach's code → coach-invite chooser; valid athlete code → athlete claim; used → "Already claimed" / "This athlete account has been set up. Sign in instead."; expired or invalid athlete code → "This code has expired" / "Ask your parent to make a new one from their Gradus settings."; valid guardian code with **no** token (or no native claim handler) → card "Guardian claim" / "Claiming an athlete as their guardian happens on gradus.training for now." with button "Open on gradus.training" (opens `https://gradus.training/i/{code}` in the browser; iOS `webHandoff`, `GradusWeb.invite(code:)`); valid guardian claim with a token → open `/g/<token>` (signed out: route waits for sign-in, sign-up stack cleared, toast "Sign in or create your account to claim this athlete."); used guardian → "Already claimed" / "This athlete already has a guardian on file."; unknown → "That code isn't valid" / "Check the letters and numbers and try again."
- **`/i/<code>` routing:** incomplete code → error toast "That invite code isn't valid."; during launch → held until `/me`; signed out → `[chooser, invite(code)]`; parent/athlete mid-onboarding or coach not yet onboarded → stash it, toast "Invite noted. It links when you finish setting up."; signed-in parent → Settings → athletes with the code pre-filled, athlete → Settings → coaches, toast "Link the coach from here with their code."; signed-in onboarded coach → claim as parent invite then adult-athlete invite (toasts "Linked to the parent's account" / "Linked to the athlete's account" / message or "Couldn't claim that invite."); org admin or no role → "Invite codes are for coach, parent, and athlete accounts."
- Tests: port `routing` and `OnboardingTests.inviteCodeText`, plus Android cases: "`abcd0o1i` normalizes to `ABCDOI`" (0 and 1 dropped, O and I kept); "a ninth character never shows"; "`https://gradus.training/i/abcdoi23` extracts `ABCDOI23`"; "a link with a 7-character code extracts nothing"; "a bare 9-character string extracts nothing".

#### 7.1.19 Local stash and persistence

- `PendingSignUp {kind, promoCode, inviteCode, userID, setup {firstName, lastName, primarySport {key,label,isCustom}, athletes [{id, firstName, lastName, birthdate}], birthdate, guardianEmail, requestedSport}}` under key `gradus.onboarding.pendingSignUp`, JSON field names identical to iOS. Saved empty → removed. `stamp(userId)` claims an unstamped stash at session adoption; `load(for: userId)` clears another account's stash. Cleared on onboarding finish and on sign-out.
- `completesCoach` = names + primary sport; `completesParent` = names + a complete athlete; `completesAdultAthlete` = names + a valid birthdate.
- Excluded from Auto Backup and device-to-device transfer; never logged. The under-13 birthdate is never persisted.
- Tests: port `OnboardingTests.pendingSignUp` ("survives a relaunch and clears when empty") plus a test that another user's stash is dropped.

### 7.2 Coach — roster and schedule

**Scope.** The coach's Roster tab and everything it presents: the Schedule / Athletes / Invoicing segments, sport filter, week strip and day agenda, lesson rows, the lesson slot sheet, the floating add button, the "Add an athlete" hub (share invite, enter a code, new athlete, import schedule), the athlete detail screen, the Up next briefing card, lesson wrap-ups, the "Get set up" checklist bubble, the coach visibility requests banner, schedule import, and Sample Athlete. The Invoicing segment and the athlete detail's billing section belong to §7.11; the post-event cards and the athlete detail's competition results section belong to §7.10; the coach visibility sheet's internals belong to §7.7/§7.12; the plan editor that "Edit plan" / "New plan" open belongs to §7.3.

**Toasts.** In this section "snackbar" means the Gradus toast host of §7.13.3 (info, success and error kinds; errors never auto-dismiss), not Material `SnackbarHost`.

**Reference implementation.** iOS `Packages/FeatureRoster/**` (RosterView, RosterModel, AthleteDetailView/Model, RosterDependencies, Components/*, ScheduleImport/*) and `Packages/GradusCore/Sources/GradusCore/Roster/*` at HEAD 91c6af2. Where the iOS PRD §7.2 table and the code disagree, the code wins (A2); each such case is called out below as **[code wins]**.

**Android module layout.** `:feature:roster` (screens, ViewModels), with pure logic in `:core:data` (`roster` package: `LessonRecurrence`, `WeekSchedule`, `LessonTime`, `RosterModels`, `SampleAthlete`, `CoachChecklist`, `UpNext`, `ScheduleImportModels`, `ScheduleImportGrouping`, `ScheduleImportValidation`, `ScheduleImportCopy`). Pure logic has no Android imports so it runs in plain JUnit 5 (§9). The shared invite cards (`ShareInviteCard`, `InviteCodeEntryCard`) live in `:feature:onboarding` and are reused by the Settings connections hub (§7.12), exactly as iOS extracted them to `FeatureOnboarding` (iOS docs/README.md I14).
