#### 7.2.19 Tests (port every iOS test; names follow the iOS `@Test` titles)

- **Recurrence and week:** all 17 `lesson-recurrence.json` vectors; Monday-first week from a Sunday; `upNext` 120-minute window, started-not-ended counts, ended excluded; overrides (canceled hidden, rescheduled times).
- **RosterViewModel** (from `RosterModelTests.swift`): New athlete revalidates roster only (304 writes nothing, skips summaries); load + summaries + this week + today; validator sent, 304 keeps roster, cache serves next launch; week navigation keeps weekday and jump returns to today; slot writes live update in place; offline slot writes queue, show at once, count as pending; queued write drops the etag; server refusal leaves roster unchanged with the message; wrap-up prompt once per lesson, recording clears it, "not now" keeps the banner; push reopens a dismissed prompt and says when nothing is waiting; offline push says it couldn't check; prompt held under another presentation with the banner standing in, never neither; banner tap for several opens the list and answers a held prompt; banner tap is "requested" past the celebration hold, the push is not; TalkBack hears the hand-off once; `activePlans` read fresh and empty (not thrown) when unwired; briefings load on demand, cache per lesson, refresh bypasses; Sample Athlete appears for an empty figure skating roster, dismissal persists; add and remove round-trip; briefing request focuses the pushed athlete in back-to-back lessons; stale request (> 10 min) ignored.
- **Athlete detail:** detail + practice targets, and **no** request to the 30-day summary endpoint (A64); sample from fixtures with no request; Gradus starter and athlete-made plans show their tag and no Adopt action (design handoff §7, Athlete card); goal authorship decode tolerates absence, names, date format; other-coach meta (counts / locked / "No shared plans yet").
- **Getting started:** current step = first not done; family-entered schedule copy; minimised remembered per coach; a failed re-read after a successful load keeps the last checklist.
- **Added by Android review:** `ApiError.userMessage` maps `roster_full` to "Your roster is full on your current plan."; `LessonTime` compact/long (0, 750, 1020); Sample Athlete start/end at nowMinute 600, 602, 603, 1400; goals empty-state fallback "`AthleteFirst` hasn't set goals yet." when not self-managed and `parentFirstName` is null (GoalAuthorship tests); practice target "abc" + Done → `PUT hoursPerWeek 0` when the current value is not 0; `ShareInviteCopy.shareText`; route parsing for every row in §7.2.21 (including `v != 1` ignored and `/coach/roster/briefing` with no id → plain Up next); camera row visible on a Pixel (instrumented); process-death restore of a pending capture; 8160×6120 downscale under a 256 MB heap; briefing error → collapse/expand retries; failed load with cache shows no error UI. Gated on §7.2.20 O1: "Editing a biweekly slot's time keeps `frequency = biweekly` and `startsOn` in the PATCH body" (until decided, the test asserts the iOS body).
- **Schedule import:** grouping (merge, athlete-email default, sample filtered, unreadable flags); cap decisions (nil limit, room, on-roster, limit 0, limit 50); copy (outcome lines, roster_full skipped and failed, verbatim non-cap failure, unknown status); validation (past midnight, duplicate, blank email, unresolved slot, skipped group). Blank email is a **soft warning**: the error line shows, but it does not block commit. Name the Kotlin test `blankEmailIsFlaggedButDoesNotBlockCommit`; the iOS title "A blank email is flagged, and blocks commit even though the slots are otherwise ready" is wrong, and its assertion (`canCommit(group) == true`, `ScheduleImportCopyTests.swift:64`) is the spec; model (offline refuses camera/photo and commit; round trip; mixed resolved/unresolved group still sent; zero-resolved group synthesises outcome; 5xx retry keeps key, edit mints new key; email edit changes key); downscaler fixtures.
- **Compose UI / screenshot (Roborazzi or Paparazzi, §9):** roster Schedule with sample, Athletes with each claim chip, lesson sheet each mode, New athlete minor vs adult, hub steps, import review with on-roster / over-cap / unreadable rows, done, athlete detail with differing goals; light and dark; font scale 1.0 and 2.0.
- **Schedule import from a .csv** (port `ScheduleImportCSVTests`, iOS #131): headers and aliases; tab delimiter; quotes; BOM; `#` lines; each field parser's table; the missing-column, empty and no-row errors; the two note texts; sport matching by key and label; the encoding fallback (a CP1252 "José"). The template parses to its three example rows; review notes appear on the card and in the announcement; a .csv reaches review offline, and Import stays disabled offline.

#### 7.2.21 Entry points: App Links, `gradus://` and pushes (iOS `AppRoute.swift`, `AppModel.apply(route:)`; see §6.10, §6.6)

Parsing is a Kotlin port of `RouteParser` (`GradusCore/Routing/AppRoute.swift`) in `:core:data`. App Links are verified for host `gradus.training`; `gradus://` is the custom scheme, with the first path segment in the host position (`gradus://coach/roster`).

| Source | Route | Android action |
|---|---|---|
| `https://gradus.training/coach/roster`, `gradus://coach/roster` | `.roster` | Select the Roster tab, pop its stack to the root |
| `https://gradus.training/coach/roster/briefing/{athleteId}`, `gradus://…` | `.upNextBriefing(athleteId)` | Roster root, then `requestBriefing(athleteId)` (§7.2.8: Schedule segment, filter cleared, this week, today, card auto-expands within 10 min) |
| `/coach/roster/briefing` with no id | `.upNextBriefing(nil)` | Roster root; plain Up next card |
| Any other `/coach/roster/<x>` | `.roster` | Roster root (builds before the briefing route did the same) |
| `https://gradus.training/coach/wrap-ups`, `gradus://coach/wrap-ups` | `.wrapUps` | Roster root, then `openWrapUpsFromLink()` (§7.2.10) |
| FCM data message with the flat keys `type`, `route`, `v = "1"` (§6.6.2, A40) and route `coach/roster`, `coach/roster/briefing/<id>`, `coach/wrap-ups` | Same as above | Same. Payloads whose `v` is not exactly `"1"` are ignored |

- All three routes need a session: signed out → sign in, then the route continues (iOS `pendingRoute`).
- An account whose role has no Roster tab (parent, athlete) → snackbar "That page isn't available for your account." and no tab change (**[code wins]**: `AppModel` shows this toast; it does not open the role home).
- A route into a tab closes the Live Board cover first (§6.9).
- **Notifications.** On Android the app itself posts the notification for an FCM data message. Both roster pushes post on the §6.6 channel for their type (both on the `lessons` channel, "Lesson reminders"; §6.6.4), with the title and body the server sends. Tapping either one opens the route through the §6.10 router (`PendingIntent` to the single activity with the route string). Without the Android 13+ `POST_NOTIFICATIONS` grant nothing is posted. The foreground 60 s wrap-up check (§7.2.10) is then the fallback, and the briefing card still shows from `upNext` without the push.

### 7.3 Coach — plans and move library

iOS §7.3; implementation `Packages/FeaturePlans/**` at HEAD 91c6af2, with #52 and #53 at `fd78810` (iOS #128, #129; contract web `5db82531`). Android screens: `PlansListScreen` (Plans tab root, segments **Plans** / **Move library**), `PlanEditorScreen`, `MoveSheet`, `MovePickerSheet` (with its "New move" page, #53), `ConflictSheet` (the #52 409 bench-choice fallback only), `SharedPlanScreen`. Analytics areas (§6.12): Plans tab and plan screens → `plans`; shared plan → `plans`.

Where the iOS PRD text and the code differ, the code wins (A2) and the row says so.

| Feature | iOS requirement (source) | Android requirement | Pri |

| Plans list | Segments, filter strip, cards, swipe/long-press delete, search in library, cached offline (§7.3; `PlansListView`, `PlansListModel`) | Compose list below; `SingleChoiceSegmentedButtonRow` for segments; chips with `DropdownMenu`s for filters; `SwipeToDismissBox` (end-to-start) plus long-press `DropdownMenu` for delete; `PullToRefreshBox` | P0 |
| Plan editor | Inline fields, moves, library picker, reorder, practice log, AI summary, share (§7.3; `PlanDetailView`, `PlanDetailModel`). **Redesigned** (`ad1e9bf`, `44529b6`): drafts are built in ticked steps (Assign to, Name, Moves), a move is read first and edited only after its pen is tapped, the target is the `TargetStepper`, reorder and delete live in a ⋯ menu, voice/generated edits are change tags | `PlanEditorScreen` as specified below. **Reorder is up/down arrow buttons** at HEAD (the PRD said drag-to-reorder; iOS only drags on iPad, which is out of 1.0 per #50). Android ships the arrows; drag is deferred with adaptive layouts (A4) | P0 |
| Status | Activate / Bench / Delete; no cap on active plans per athlete (#52): Activate goes straight through, with no bench or replace prompt (`PlanDetailModel.activateTapped`). Only a server not yet published with #52 answers 409 `bench_choice_required`, which opens the choose-one-to-bench sheet (`offerBenchChoice`, `ConflictSheet`) | Same: no active-plans read and no prompt before activation; the 409 fallback sheet as in §7.3.5 | P0 |
| Bench or remove "why?" | Skippable prompt (#17), labels *Goal reached / On hold / No longer needed* (#20, iOS #86); wire `landed_it` / `parking_it` / `changed_direction` | Same. Note: iOS PRD Appendix A says `landed / parked / dropped`; the **contract and code** use `landed_it / parking_it / changed_direction` (`SkillReason`, `SkillReasonTests.theAnswersMatchTheContractOnBothEndpoints`). Android uses the contract values | P1 (L2) |

Only the name must be typed: sport, category and 10 reps are prefilled. **Save to library & add** saves and adds; a same-name move offers Add the existing one / Overwrite / Keep both. Coaches only (`NewPlanMoveView`, `PlanDetailModel.createMoveAndAdd`) | A second page inside the `MovePickerSheet` `ModalBottomSheet` (§7.3.8a B) | P0 |

#### 7.3.1 Plans list (`PlansListScreen`)

**Header.** No top app bar (§8.4). `PageTitle("Plans")` whose accessory is the sync label "*n* to sync" with a sync icon (`plans.pending`), shown when queued plan writes exist (`isPlansPath` mutations in `pending` or `inFlight`); then Live inline when the account shows it (`d23ab4a`).

**Segments.** "Plans" | "Move library". Changing segment reloads that segment.

**Filter strip (Plans segment)**, horizontally scrollable:

| Chip | Options | Rules |
|---|---|---|
| Plan type (always shown, selected style, filter icon) | "Active", "Drafts", "Benched", "Templates" (default Active) | Maps to `GET /coach/plans?kind=plan&status=active|draft|benched` or `kind=template` |
| Athlete | "All athletes" + roster names | Disabled and at 50% opacity on Templates; ignored in the query on Templates |
| Sport | "All sports" + sports | Shown only when the coach has more than one sport or one is selected; labels from `CoachSports.displayLabel` (e.g. `figure_skating` → "Figure Skating") |

**Loading and errors.** First load with nothing cached: three redacted placeholder cards reading "Loading…". Load error with nothing cached: state view "Couldn't load your plans", the error message, button "Try again".

**Empty states.**
- **How-to bubble** (#28, web #142): shown instead of the list only while the coach has **no plans of any kind** (`hasAnyPlan == false`, from an unfiltered `GET /coach/plans?kind=plan` fetched only when the current list is empty; cached and conditional). Never shown for an empty filter (QA 2026-09-26). Deleting the last plan brings it back. Offline with no cached answer: unknown, no bubble (`PlansListModel.refreshHasAnyPlan`; tests `theHowToBubbleShowsOnlyWithNoPlansAtAll`, `deletingTheLastPlanBringsTheHowToBubbleBack`).
  - Bubble title and open label "How to make a plan", close label "Minimize how to make a plan", open on arrival, nothing persisted.
  - Steps: (1) "Start a new plan" — "Tap the + button to open a blank plan and give it a title." CTA "Create a plan"; (2) "Add moves from your library" — "Pick moves, set reps or time, and order them for the session." CTA "Open move library" (switches segment); (3) "Assign it and activate" — "Choose an athlete, then activate so they can see and log it." CTA "Create a plan". Current step: the first. (`PlanHelpBubble.swift`.) Android renders it with the shared Gradus `HelpBubble` component (§8) anchored under the segments.
- **Empty filter**: "No active plans." / "No drafts." / "No benched plans." / "No templates yet."; with an athlete filter (not Templates): "No active plans for *Name*." etc. (`emptyFilterMessage`).

**Plan card** (`PlanCardView`; borderless, `cardEdge`): 5 dp edge stripe (`flowAccent` when active or a template, `divider` otherwise); caption line = athlete name, else an uppercase mono caption: "Template" (template), "Shared" (active, no athlete), "Unassigned" (no athlete), "Draft", "Benched" (`PlanSummary.caption`); title (or "Untitled plan"); right-aligned "0 sessions" / "1 session" / "*n* sessions"; flow bars (§7.6.6). A benched plan card (`kind == plan && status == benched`) is drawn at **70% opacity**, as on iOS (`PlanCardView.swift:38` `.opacity(... ? 0.7 : 1)`; Compose `Modifier.alpha(0.7f)`). Replacing the dimming with the runner list's full-contrast `elevated` treatment (WCAG 1.4.6) is a joint iOS + Android proposal, §12 N51, not an Android-only change (A2). Tap opens the editor.

**Delete from the list.** Allowed on the **Drafts, Benched and Templates** filters (`deletable`; the PRD said drafts only, code allows benched too and the server's `deletePlan` agrees; `PlansTests.benchedPlansDeleteLikeDraftsButActiveOnesRefuse`). Swipe end-to-start reveals "Delete"; long-press menu "Delete plan"; both open a confirm dialog `Delete "<title or this plan>"?` / "This can't be undone." / "Delete" / "Cancel". Optimistic removal; success toast "Plan deleted". Network (status 0) or 5xx with an outbox: enqueue `DELETE /plans/{id}` labeled "Delete <title or plan>", toast "Deleted — it syncs when you're back online.", and **drop the list ETags** so the next load refetches (`queuedDeleteDropsTheEtagSoTheNextLoadFetches`). Other errors restore the row and toast the error.

**FABs** (bottom-end, stacked): on Plans, the voice FAB (create mode; §7.4) above the "+" FAB; on Move library, "+" only. "+" content description "New plan" / "New move". "+" on Plans creates a draft for the current athlete filter (`POST /coach/plans {kind:"plan", athleteId}`), or a **template** on the Templates filter (`kind:"template"`, no athlete), then opens it; it shows a busy state while creating; errors toast (`createDraftUsesTheAthleteFilterAndTemplatesFilter`). A voice result opens the new plan with its highlights (carried in an in-memory `VoiceTouchedStash` keyed by plan id, taken once by the editor).

**Pending voice drain.** On tab entry and on every foreground, parked coach recordings are sent (§7.4 `PendingVoice.drain`), each result opening its plan.

**Caching and refresh** (iOS §6.5: plans on tab open, 7-day staleness): cache-first from the `plans.json` snapshot (§6.5), then the network with `If-None-Match` per filter key `kind|status|athleteId|sport`; a 304 keeps the cached list. Foreground → reload. Pull to refresh → drop ETags and reload. Athlete and sport options load from the roster in parallel.

#### 7.3.2 Move library segment

- `GradusSearchField` "Search moves" (clear button content description "Clear search"; §8.3), matching name, category or cue, case-insensitive, trimmed. Sport chips "All" + each sport present, shown when the library has more than one sport.
- Grouped by category (sorted). **Every category starts folded** (`7855ee6`, Mariah 2026-10-15): a `CategoryHeader` row (display headline, trailing chevron rotated −90° when folded, 48 dp, heading semantics, `stateDescription` "Expanded" or "Collapsed, `N` move(s)", test tag `library.section.{category}`) toggles it, with a snappy 0.2 s spring and no animation under Remove animations. The open set is held in the screen's ViewModel for the session (not persisted). **A typed search opens every category** so a match is never hidden, and while a query is typed, taps on a header do nothing (`7855ee6` follow-up). Each move row: name (bold, 2 lines max), uppercase target label ("10 reps", "3 mins"), cue (2 lines), chevron. Tap opens `MoveSheet` in edit mode.
- States: "Loading your moves…" placeholder; error "Couldn't load your library" + "Try again"; empty library: "Your move library is empty. Add a move with + or set up sports in your profile to load the starter move library."; no match: "No moves match." (no query and no sport chip) else "No moves match your filters." **Note:** at HEAD the condition is inverted relative to its wording (`libraryEmptyMessage` returns "No moves match." when the query and sport chip are both empty, which only happens if the library is empty, already handled above). Android shows "No moves match your filters." whenever a query or chip is active and the filtered list is empty (proposed: equivalent outcome, correct wording).
- Library loads cache-first with `If-None-Match`; the very first fetch is written to the cache (`theVeryFirstLibraryLoadCachesTheLibraryAndItsEtag`). Library staleness 30 days (iOS §6.5).

#### 7.3.2a Bulk upload (.csv) (`MoveImportFlow`, coach only; iOS #132, Mariah 2026-10-12)

- **Entry.** On the Move library segment, a **coach's** + FAB opens a menu instead of acting directly: "New move" (opens `MoveSheet` new; test tag `library.newMove`) and "Bulk upload (.csv)" (table icon; `library.import`). The FAB's content description is "Add moves", with hint "Make one move, or upload many from a .csv." (`plans.add`). Android uses a `DropdownMenu` anchored to the FAB, the same pattern as the Roster FAB menu. On the Plans segment the FAB is unchanged ("New plan").
- **Sheet.** Full-height `ModalBottomSheet` with a drag handle. Top bar: `GradusSheetHeader` with "Close" (`moveImport.cancel`; iOS still says "Cancel", A66, §12 N97) on source and review; on review the action "Import {n}" / "Importing…" (`moveImport.commit`), enabled when not importing, online and `n > 0`. Titles: "Import moves" → "Review {n} move(s)" ("move" when 1) → "Import complete".
- **Source.**
  - A row card with a table icon, "Choose a .csv file", "From Excel, Numbers, or Google Sheets" and a chevron (`moveImport.chooseCSV`). It opens the SAF picker with the A58 MIME list. A provider failure shows "Couldn't open that file.".
  - "Get the CSV template" (`moveImport.template`; same hint and share mechanics as §7.2.15). It shares `gradus-move-library-template.csv` (UTF-8 with BOM) with the iOS content verbatim:
    ```
    # GRADUS MOVE LIBRARY — one row per move, then upload this file.
    # Lines starting with # are ignored. Keep the header row below. Delete the example rows.
    #
    # name         Required. A name already in your library is skipped unless you choose Replace.
    # category     Required. e.g. Jumps, Spins, Footwork, Strength
    # sport        Leave blank to use your sport.
    # target       How much each time: 10 reps, 3 reps, 5 min. A number alone means reps.
    # cue          What to think about while doing it.
    # why          Why it matters.
    # description  How to do it.
    #
    name,category,sport,target,cue,why,description
    Waltz jump,Jumps,,5 reps,Arms in on the takeoff,Builds the edge for every jump after it,"Forward outside edge, half rotation, land back outside"
    Scratch spin,Spins,,3 reps,Pull in slowly,Centering for faster spins,
    Plank hold,Strength,,2 min,Hips level,A steady core for landings,
    ```
  - The source error line, announced (`moveImport.sourceError`).
- **Reading the file** (a 1:1 port of `MoveLibraryCSV.parse` and the shared `CSVTable`; local, works offline):
  - Decoding, delimiter, quotes, BOM and `#` lines as in §7.2.15. An undecodable file → "Couldn't read that file. Save it as a .csv and try again.".
  - Header aliases: `move`/`move_name`/`skill`/`title` → `name`; `group`/`type` → `category`; `amount`/`default_target`/`reps`/`target_value` → `target`; `unit`/`target_kind` → `target_unit`; `notes`/`instructions` → `description`; `coaching_cue` → `cue`; `reason` → `why`.
  - File errors: missing `name` or `category` → "Missing column(s): {list}. Get the template for the exact headers."; "That file looks empty."; "No moves found in that file."; more than 500 data rows → "That file has {n} moves. Import up to 500 at a time.".
  - Per-row problems (the row can't be imported): "No name", "Name is over 120 characters", "No category", "Category is over 64 characters", "Cue is over 1000 characters", "Why is over 1000 characters", "Description is over 2000 characters", "\"{raw}\" isn't one of your sports", "Add your sport in your profile first".
  - Sport: blank → the coach's first sport (or, before the profile loads, the library's own sports, sorted).
  - Target (`target` + `target_unit` joined by a space): `m:ss` → minutes with 2 decimals; a number from 0 to 10,000 (exclusive of 0) with a unit. Reps: none, `x`, `rep(s)`, `time(s)`, `r`. Minutes: `m`, `min(s)`, `minute(s)`, `min.`. Seconds (`s`, `sec(s)`, `second(s)`, `sec.`) become minutes with 2 decimals. Blank → 10 reps. Unreadable → 10 reps with the note "Couldn't read the target \"{raw}\", so it's 10 reps".
  - Rows are matched against the loaded library by trimmed, lowercased name (`existingMoveId`). A name repeated earlier in the file marks the row "Same name as an earlier row".
- **Review** (sections only when non-empty; each has the eyebrow "{Title} · {count}" and a card):
  - **"Already in your library"**: a "Replace all" chip (toggles every existing row; selected when all are Replace; `moveImport.replaceAll`), then per row the move label and two single-choice chips, "Skip" (default) and "Replace". TalkBack labels "Skip {name}" / "Replace {name}".
  - **"New"**: move labels.
  - **"Can't import"**: the name (or "Row {n}"), and the problems joined " · " in destructive ink.
  - The move label: bold name; "{category} · {amount} {min|reps}" (the amount is whole, or one decimal); each note with a warning icon in tertiary.
  - Announcement on entering review: "{rows} moves found. {sendCount} ready to import.".
  - The import error line, announced (`moveImport.importError`).
- **Import** (online-only, one call, never queued):
  - Offline → "You're offline. Try again when you're back online.". Nothing to send → "Nothing to import yet.".
  - `POST /api/v1/coach/moves/import {moves: [{sport, category, name, description, cue, why, defaultTargetKind: reps|mins, defaultTargetValue, onConflict: skip|overwrite}]}` with only the rows that will change the library: ready rows that are new, or existing rows set to Replace (`overwrite`).
  - `Idempotency-Key = "<attemptId>-<first 12 bytes of SHA-256(sorted-keys payload JSON) as hex>"`. That is the same derivation as the schedule-import commit (§7.2.15). A fresh `attemptId` comes with each file read, so an unchanged retry replays and any Replace toggle changes the key.
  - The reply is `{results: [{index, name, status: created|updated|skipped, reason?: name_exists|duplicate_in_file, moveId?}], created, updated, skipped}`. Unknown `status` and `reason` values decode to `unknown`.
  - An error shows `ApiError.userMessage` inline.
- **Done** (the same shape as the roster import's Done):
  - Eyebrow summary "{created} added[ · {updated} replaced][ · {skipped + rows not sent} skipped]" (`moveImport.summary`).
  - One card per file row, in file order: a check icon (success) or exclamation icon. Detail: "Added to {category}" / "Replaced the library move" / "Already in your library" / "Skipped" / the row's problems / "Same name as an earlier row".
  - A full-width primary "Done" / "Done…" (`moveImport.done`) invalidates and reloads the library, then closes.
- **Tests:** port `MoveImportTests`. Cover the parser and each problem string, the target parsing table, aliases, the 500 cap, duplicate-in-file, the split into New / Already / Can't, Replace all, the payload containing only `willSend` rows with `onConflict`, the key derivation (stable on retry, changed by a toggle), outcome lines in file order, the summary line, offline refusal, and a coach-only FAB menu (no menu in the athlete Library).

#### 7.3.3 Move sheet (`MoveSheet`, create and edit)

Full-height sheet, `GradusSheetHeader` with "Close", the title "New move" / "Edit move", and "Save" ("Saving…" while saving; disabled until name, sport and a category are set, and **while a Draft with AI call runs**). The fields are the shared `MoveFormFields` (§7.3.8a A). For coaches, **Draft with AI** heads the card that holds the cue, why and description it fills in (`canDraft = !routes.isAthlete`; §7.3.8a C–F).

| Field | Control and copy |
|---|---|
| Name | placeholder "Name this move" (new) / "Add a name" |
| Sport | `GradusMenuPicker` (unboxed, flush with its eyebrow label; §8.6.6); options = sports in the library ∪ the coach's sports ∪ current; placeholder "Sport"; a new move defaults to the first option |
| Category | `GradusMenuPicker` "Choose…" (or "Type one below" when there are no options) listing the coach's categories and the seeded curriculum categories for that sport (`seedCategories`, sport keys compared lowercased with spaces → `_`); with nothing chosen a text field "e.g. Forehand, Footwork, Strength" |
| Target | **`TargetStepper`** "− 10 reps +" (§8.6.6; default 10 reps). Tap the unit to switch to minutes. There is no segmented control and no number field (`ad1e9bf`; the old 0…10000 clamp and comma parsing are gone with the field) |
| Draft card | One borderless `GradusCard` (padding 14) holding, in order: the **Draft with AI** controls (coach only), **Cue** "One line the athlete can repeat to themselves" (1–3 lines), **Why this matters** "What this move develops, in plain language" (1–3 lines), **Description** "How to perform the move, step by step" (2–6 lines). These are the three fields the AI can draft, so they sit together with the button that drafts them (`ad1e9bf`) |

Edit mode adds "Duplicate" (creates "<name> (copy)", toast "Duplicated", switches the sheet to the copy) and "Archive" (destructive) → dialog `Archive "<name>"?` / "Plans that use this move keep their copy. It disappears from your library." / "Archive" / "Keep it"; toast "Move archived"; offline/5xx: enqueue `POST /coach/moves/{id}/archive` ("Archive move"), toast "Archived — it syncs when you're back online.", drop the library ETag.

Save → `PUT /coach/moves` `[idem]`. Same-name conflict reply → dialog `A move named "<name>" already exists` / "Overwrite replaces the existing move's fields with these. Keep both saves this one under the same name." / "Overwrite it" (destructive, sends `overwriteMoveId`) / "Keep both" / "Cancel". "Keep both" on a **new** move renames it "<name> (2)" (the server checks names on insert); on an existing move it resaves under its own id. Success toast "Move added" / "Move saved".

#### 7.3.4 Plan editor (`PlanEditorScreen`, coach mode)

**Load.** Cache-first from the plan-detail cache (the 20 most recently updated plans are kept; older evicted; the runner screen writes to the same cache, §7.6.2), then `GET /plans/{id}`; error with nothing cached: "Couldn't load this plan" + "Try again"; otherwise a progress indicator. Top bar title: **empty** (iOS `navigationTitle("")`; one title per screen, §8.6.1). The plan's name is the heading in the content. Moves start **expanded** only when the plan is a draft. Expanded is not editing: see item 7 below. Athletes (roster) and the library load in parallel. For an active plan, the session log (`GET /plans/{id}/sessions?limit=100`) and then the AI summary (`GET /plans/{id}/sessions/summary`) load.

**Placeholder route `new:<athleteId>`.** The roster wrap-up prompt (§7.2) opens the editor with `new:<athleteId>` when the athlete has no active plan: create a draft for that athlete and **replace** the placeholder destination with the real plan (no pop-then-push race) (`newPlaceholderIdCreatesADraftAndRedirectsInsteadOfFetching`).

**Top bar actions** (only when `isOwner`): Share (shown when the plan is active or a template; content description "Share plan") and the inline voice mic (edit mode, §7.4).

**Body, top to bottom** (`PlanDetailView.swift` at `c8f83d6`):

1. **Read-only banner** when not the owner (lock icon): "Written by *first name*, read-only." (athlete-authored) / "*Coach Name*'s plan, read-only." / "Another coach's plan, read-only.".
2. **The heading.**
   - **A draft being built** (`status == draft`, the owner, not athlete authoring, not a template) shows the heading **"New plan"** (display title, heading semantics) and is built in **steps** (handoff §7 Plan builder). Each step has a **section tick** (§8.6.8): a pen tick in a circle once it is filled.
     1. **"Assign to"** (`44529b6`; the handoff's "For"). Done when an assignment exists. Then the **Assign to card** (item 3).
     2. **"Name"**. Done when the title is non-blank **and is not "Untitled plan"**, which counts as empty. Then a borderless card with the title `InlineField` (display title3, label hidden, placeholder "Name this plan", required).
     3. **"Moves"**. Done when the plan has at least one move. Then the moves (item 7).
   - **Otherwise** (active, benched, template, or athlete authoring): the plan name is the page heading, an `InlineField` in display title, label hidden, required. An empty commit reverts. Its placeholder is "Name this plan" in the new flow, else "Untitled plan", and it auto-enters editing in the new flow with an empty title. **"Read this plan aloud"** leads the title as a speaker icon button (`volume_up`, 48 dp, `contentDescription` "Read this plan aloud", test tag `narration.start`; it was a full-width button), so it never sits beside the title's edit pen. It appears when there are moves.
3. **Who it's for, right under the name** (Alyson 2026-10-14; it was last). This is the **Assign to card**:
   - **Plan:** "Saving…" and the voice quote when touched. A field box: empty → "Choose who this is for" in `textTertiary` with a **dashed** edge (the look the picker field adopted); chosen → the value in `accentInk`. Content description "Assign to", state "Not chosen" or the value. Menu: "Public", "Template", divider, roster athletes. The card wash is `attentionWash` when voice set the athlete.
   - **Template:** switch "Use this template"; when on, the menu "Choose an athlete" and the caption "Creates a new draft from this template." → `POST /coach/plans {kind:"plan", athleteId, fromTemplateId}` → toast "Copy created" → open the new draft.
4. **"N changes"** (subheadline Bold) while any field is voice- or AI-touched (§7.4.2). The old banner "From your voice — tweak anything, then approve." with "Looks good" is gone.
5. **Logged card** (active plans only), **folded by default** (building is about the moves; `ad1e9bf`).
   - **Header:** a 48 dp toggle row with the eyebrow "**Logged practice**" (was "Logged instances") and a chart icon, the count "0 sessions" / "*n* session(s)" (the larger of the plan's and the log's totals), and a chevron. State "Expanded"/"Collapsed".
   - **When open:**
     - flow bars;
     - the attribution line "4 sessions · 3 by Greta, 1 by a parent" (`PlanSessionLog.attributionLine`);
     - divider, then the eyebrow "Summary" with the sparkle icon and its states, unchanged: "No sessions logged yet. A summary will appear once *Greta* starts logging practice." (authoring: "…once you start logging practice."); "Reading the sessions…"; "Couldn't generate a summary right now."; else the text;
     - the collapsible "Practice log" with its count. Rows read "*Name* logged for *Athlete*" (parent) or "*Name* logged" (athlete). The second line is the flow label, or flow label · note; **each-move check-ins** (`moveRatings` non-empty) show `MoveRatingsList` instead (§8.3; `c7ed012`): one row per rated move in plan order, the move name in `textSecondary` at the start and its rating word ("Just right") in `textPrimary` at the end (caption size, one merged TalkBack node per row; a skipped move isn't listed), then the note if any. Each row has a trailing date "Oct 4" and "12 min" when ≥ 1 minute. The first 5 show, then "Show all *n*".
6. The eyebrow "What does *Greta* need to work on?" is **gone** (show, don't tell).
7. **Moves.**
   - **Collapsed row:** target number (display title3) + "min"/"reps" (caption2 `textTertiary`; content description "minutes"/"repetitions"), then the name (display subheadline) or an italic "Untitled move". At the end, the move's **change tag** when a voice or generated edit touched it ("New" tennis / "Reps" or "Minutes" / "Changed" pool; §8.6.8), then a chevron. Content description: the tag, "Expanded"/"Collapsed", and "Being read aloud".
   - **Tap to read it:** expanding shows the move **read-only**, with **no outline yet** (handoff §7). The expanded header holds:
     - the name as display title3 (the move's title; label "Move *n*", hidden);
     - an **always-visible pen** (`edit` icon, `textSecondary`, 48 dp, `contentDescription` "Edit *name*"; phones have no hover, so it is never hover-only);
     - a collapse chevron ("Collapse *name*").
   - Below the header, read-only: the target as plain text ("20 reps", display title2), then **Description** ("How to perform the move"), **Cue** ("One line to help the athlete in the moment") and **"Why this matters for this athlete"** ("Tailor it to this plan") as tap-to-edit `InlineField`s that are not yet editable.
   - **The pen switches on editing.** The move gets the **EditingOutline** (seed index + 71; §8.6.5), the pen becomes the word **"Done"** (subheadline Bold `accentInk`; content description "Done editing *name*") because a tick did not read as done, the name becomes editable, the target becomes the **`TargetStepper`**, and Description / Cue / Why become tap-to-edit with **no per-field pencils**: the text itself is the tap target, with the action label "Double-tap to edit".
   - While editing, the library link section shows (coach only, §7.3.7), then a ⋯ button (`more_horiz`, "More for *name*", test tag `plan.move.delete.{id}`). Its `DropdownMenu` holds "Move up" and "Move down" (disabled at the ends) and "Delete move" (destructive, through the "why?" prompt of §7.3.6).
   - "Done", or collapsing the move, ends editing. **The outline never shows** while the move is being read aloud, which instead gets a 3 dp `accentInk` edge, is scrolled to with no animation, and adds "Being read aloud" to its content description.
   - Card: `card` fill, radius 20, no edge when open, `cardEdge` when closed.
8. **"Add moves"** (secondary button, plus icon; TalkBack hint "Pick moves from your library, or make a new one.") → `MovePickerSheet`, which for a coach also makes a new move (§7.3.8a B).
9. **"Feedback on" card** (coach owner only, never in athlete authoring: `canEdit && !isAuthoring`; iOS `PlanDetailView.feedbackCard`, `44529b6`): eyebrow "Feedback on" (+ "Saving…" while `savingField == "feedbackScope"`), then two single-choice `GradusChip`s, **"Each move"** and **"Whole plan"**, in a selectable group. "Whole plan" is selected when `feedbackScope` is anything but `"moves"`, including absent (older servers). TalkBack hint on "Each move": "Each move gets its own rating; the plan's rating is their average." Test tags `plan.feedback.moves` / `plan.feedback.plan`. Tapping the unselected chip sends `PATCH /plans/{id} {"feedbackScope": "moves" | "plan"}` through the plan outbox path (optimistic; entity label "Feedback"; the same offline toasts as other field edits). Tapping the selected chip does nothing. `feedbackScope` is a plain string on the wire, never an enum (unknown → whole plan). Copies of a plan (fork on reassign, plan from template) keep the choice server-side. The check-in behavior is in §7.6.5.
10. **Notes card:** "Other notes on this plan", placeholder "Overall context, focus areas, encouragement…".
11. **"What you dictated"** disclosure when a transcript exists (borderless).

**Inline field behavior** (`InlineField`): tap the value to edit. There is **no pencil per field** (2026-10-13): the text is the tap target. Content description = label and value, action label "Double-tap to edit" when editable. While editing, it is a `GradusTextField`, so it gets the EditingOutline (§8.6.5). commits on IME Done (single line) or when focus leaves, **except** when focus left because the biometric lock covered the screen (§6.11): the draft waits and the field refocuses on unlock. Commit trims; unchanged values send nothing. AI-touched fields show the attention wash with a 2 dp `penOrange` underline and a "From your voice" / "Hide source" toggle revealing the quoted words.

**Assignment rules** (`PlanDetailModel.assign`, `setAthlete`):
- Template choice is deferred until the primary action ("Save to Library").
- Public on an assigned plan → `PATCH /plans/{id}` with an **explicit** `"athleteId": null`; a plan becomes a draft locally when unassigned (`offlineUnassignQueuesAnExplicitNull`, `assigningPublicClearsTheAthleteWithAnExplicitNull`). kotlinx.serialization must emit the explicit null (`explicitNulls` for this body, or a hand-built `JsonObject`).
- Choosing a different athlete on an **active** plan forks server-side: reply `{forkedId}` → toast "Created a copy. Original plan kept as-is." → open the fork; never queued offline.
- A refused save drops the pending pick so the box reads empty again (`A refused assignment drops the pick…`).
- An active plan with no athlete reopens as "Public" with nothing to choose.

**Action bar** (pinned, translucent surface, top divider):
- **No blocker line.** Why Activate is greyed out goes into the primary's TalkBack action label: "Choose who it's for in Assign to, then activate." The dashed "Choose who this is for" field already shows what is missing (`ad1e9bf`).
- **Left:** active → chip "Bench"; draft or benched → destructive chip "Delete" (benched plans delete like drafts).
- **Right:** the screen's **one lime action**, as a prominent chip (`chipProminent`) with a paper-plane icon for Activate. By state:
  - draft assigned to an athlete: **"Activate & Share with *First*"** (`PlanDetailModel.primaryActionTitle`; "Activate & Share" when the first name is unknown);
  - active: **"Update & Share"**;
  - template → "Save template" (needs a title, else toast "Give the template a title."; sets status benched; toast "Template saved"); assignment Template → "Save to Library" (clones to a template: `POST /coach/plans {kind:"template", fromPlanId}`; toast "Copy created"; **replaces** the editor with the copy in one navigation, `navigate(Plan(copyId)) { popUpTo(current) { inclusive = true } }`, and does **not** also pop the editor: iOS #157 fixed a race where dismiss and the push left a blank screen; test `saveToLibraryOpensTheTemplateWithoutPopping`); Public → "Publish & Share" / "Update & Share" when active (needs a title; mints the share link, opens the share sheet, then sets active; toast "Plan published" / "Plan updated"); otherwise "Activate & Share" / "Update & Share" (paper-plane icon; enabled only with an athlete). Activate validates: no athlete → toast "Assign an athlete first."; no title → "Give the plan a title.".
- **Tapping the primary keeps every change and clears the change tags** (`clearAllTouched()`); there is no separate approve step.
- **"Activate & Share" / "Update & Share" on an assigned plan activates only and opens no share sheet** (`PlanDetailView` `actionBarButtons`: `.activate` calls `activateTapped()`, which validates and sends the status change only; there is no active-plans lookup since #52). The label comes from the web. Only "Publish & Share" (Public) mints the link and opens the Android share sheet. The top-bar Share action is the coach's way to share an assigned active plan.
- Successful activate, bench, delete and template save pop the editor (Save to Library does not; it replaces the editor with the copy, above).

**Status writes** (`setStatus`): `POST /plans/{id}/status {status, replaceId?, reason?}` (nil fields omitted: `{"status":"benched"}` when skipped). Success toasts: "Plan activated", "Plan activated · previous plan benched", "Plan benched", "Template saved", "Saved as draft". 409 `bench_choice_required` (only from a server not yet published with #52) → read the athlete's active plans and show the bench choice (§7.3.5); when the sheet is already open, the fresh list swaps in **in place** (the sheet stays open, the pick and the "why?" answer clear). With no athlete on the plan, or no other active plan to offer, the sheet closes and the server's message is toasted. Status 0/5xx with an outbox → enqueue the same body (keeping its `reason`) labeled "<success> (<title>)", apply locally, toast "Saved — it syncs when you're back online.". Other errors close the conflict sheet so the error toast is visible.

**Toast text for offline field edits:** "Saved — it syncs when you're back online."; outbox unavailable: "You're offline. Try again when you're back online."; enqueue failure: "Couldn't save the change.". Outbox entity labels (stored with each row; no Sync Center lists them at HEAD, §6.5): "Rename plan", "Plan notes", "Assign plan", "Edit move", "Remove move", "Reorder moves".

#### 7.3.5 No cap on active plans (#52) and the 409 bench-choice fallback

**The rule (decision #52, 2026-10-11; web #223, iOS #128).** A coach can have any number of plans active for one athlete. Activate on a coach's assigned plan validates and then sends `POST /plans/{id}/status {"status":"active"}` **directly**. There is no `GET /coach/athletes/{athleteId}/active-plans` read first, no "keep both or replace" prompt, and no default choice (`PlanDetailModel.activateTapped` → `performActivate(replaceId: nil)`). The validation messages are unchanged: "Assign an athlete first." and "Give the plan a title.". On success the toast is "Plan activated" and the editor pops. There never was a database-level cap. `replaceId` stays optional in the contract: it benches that plan in the same step when it is another of this athlete's active plans from this coach. Otherwise nothing is benched and the activation still goes through.

**The 409 fallback (kept, as on iOS).** A server not yet published with #52 can still answer 409 `bench_choice_required` to any coach status write that activates (Activate & Share, Publish & Share, a queued replay). `PlanDetailModel.setStatus` → `offerBenchChoice(athleteId:after:)`:
- If the plan has no athlete, close the sheet if it is open and toast the server's message (`ApiError.userMessage`).
- Otherwise read `GET /coach/athletes/{athleteId}/active-plans?excludePlanId={id}`, fresh and never cached.
  - Empty → close the sheet if it is open and toast the server's message. Never show an empty sheet.
  - Non-empty → clear the pick (`chosenReplaceId = null`) and open `ConflictSheet` with the list (choose-bench, **nothing preselected**). If the sheet is already open, the list swaps in place.
  - The read fails → close the sheet and toast the error (`userMessage`).

Android: a `ModalBottomSheet` with `skipPartiallyExpanded = true`, a `GradusSheetHeader` with "Close" (closes the sheet and clears the conflict; `ad1e9bf`), scrolling content and the action buttons **pinned** below. Nothing may be cut off at any font scale (TestFlight QA 2026-09-26). Copy, verbatim (`LibraryLinkSection.swift` `ConflictSheet` at `fd78810`; *Name* = the athlete's first name, falling back to "This athlete"):

| Part | Copy |
|---|---|
| Heading (a heading node) | "Pick a plan to bench" |
| Body | "Pick one of *Name*'s plans to bench so this one can go live. Nothing is deleted." |
| Choices (radio rows, no detail line) | "Bench “*Plan*”", one per active plan (*Plan* = `displayTitle`, "Untitled plan" when empty) |
| Primary | "Bench & activate", disabled until a plan is picked and while saving → `performActivate(replaceId = picked, reason)`; success toast "Plan activated · previous plan benched" |
| Secondary | "Save as draft instead" → `POST .../status {"status":"draft"}`, toast "Saved as draft" |

**The optional "why?"** appears under the choices once a plan to bench is picked. The eyebrow is "Why is “*Plan*” coming off? (optional)" and the text is "Your answer helps Gradus learn *Name*'s pace. Tap your answer again to clear it." (here *Name* falls back to "your athlete"). Three radio rows follow, with no Skip row:

| Label | Detail line | Wire |
|---|---|---|
| "Goal reached" | "*Name* can do what this plan worked on." (fallback "Your athlete can…") | `landed_it` |
| "On hold" | "Not right now. You plan to come back to it." | `parking_it` |
| "No longer needed" | "*Name*'s goals or needs have changed." (fallback "Your athlete's goals or needs have changed.") | `changed_direction` |

Tapping the chosen answer again clears it (TalkBack hint "Double-tap again to clear your answer."). Each row is one accessibility node with `selected` state (`Modifier.selectable` / `Role.RadioButton`), at least 48 dp tall. The answer is sent only with a `replaceId` and is recorded **against the plan being benched** (`performActivate` drops it when nothing is replaced; `WhyPromptTests.benchingInTheFallbackSendsTheAnswerForTheBenchedPlanAndNeverWithoutOne`). The answer resets when a fresh list swaps in or the picked plan changes. The primary button does not dismiss the sheet; the sheet closes when the call ends, or a repeated 409 swaps in a fresh list (`aRepeated409KeepsTheSheetOpenWithAFreshList`). Status 0/5xx while the sheet is open queues as in §7.3.4 and closes the sheet. Any other error closes the sheet so the toast is visible.

#### 7.3.6 Bench and remove "why?" prompts (#17, #20, L2)

Applies only when `!isAuthoring && kind == plan && athleteId != null && status != draft` (`whyPromptApplies`): never for templates, unassigned plans, drafts still being built, or deleting a whole plan (`WhyPromptTests.draftsStillBeingBuiltNeverAsk`, `templatesNeverAsk`).

| Prompt | Title | Message | Buttons |
|---|---|---|---|
| Bench (applies) | "Bench this plan?" | "Why are you benching it? Your answer helps Gradus learn *Name*'s pace. The athlete stops seeing the plan until you activate it again. Nothing is deleted." | "Goal reached", "On hold", "No longer needed", "Bench without a reason", "Keep it active" (cancel) |
| Bench (does not apply) | "Bench this plan?" | "The athlete stops seeing it in their runner until you activate it again. Nothing is deleted." | "Bench" (destructive), "Keep it active" |
| Remove a move (applies) | `Remove "<move name>"?` | "Why is it coming out? Your answer helps Gradus learn *Name*'s pace." | "Goal reached", "On hold", "No longer needed", "Remove without a reason", "Keep it" (cancel) |

Removal without the prompt happens immediately. Android renders the multi-button prompts as an M3 `AlertDialog` whose `text` slot holds the message and a vertical stack of full-width `TextButton`s (an iOS alert with five actions has no two-button Material equivalent); TalkBack reads all options in order; targets ≥ 48 dp. The bench answer rides in the status body `reason`; the removal answer rides as a **query** `DELETE /plans/{id}/moves/{moveId}?reason=parking_it` (no body). The outbox stores the full path **with** its query and the transport splits path and query on replay, percent-encoding raw queries (`SkillReasonTests.theTransportKeepsTheQueryOutOfThePath`). Offline answers queue with the edit (`offlineAnswersQueueWithTheEdit`, `aBenchThatFallsBackToTheOutboxKeepsItsAnswer`). The pending removal's name is kept after the dialog closes so the title does not flash while animating out.

#### 7.3.7 Library link section (per expanded move, coach only)

- Plan-only move (`moveId == null`): "Not in your library yet" + "Save to library" (books icon), disabled until the move has a cue and a why, with the hint "Add a cue and a why before saving this move to your library.". Opens an inline form: Sport and Category as unboxed `GradusMenuPicker`s ("Sport"; "Type one…" + library and curriculum categories for that sport; free text "e.g. Forehand, Footwork, Strength" when none chosen), "Cancel" (an inline mini-form keeps Cancel, §8.6.2), and "Save to library" as an **outlined** chip (it was prominent; `ad1e9bf`) → `POST /coach/moves/from-plan-move {planMoveId, sport, category, overwriteMoveId?}`; toast "Saved to your move library"; reload.
- Linked and drifted (`differsFromLibrary`: any of name, description, cue, why, target kind or value differs from `libraryMove`): "Edited since it was linked to your library" + "Update library move" (`POST /coach/moves/{id}/update-from-plan-move`, toast "Library move updated") and "Save as new" (form with "Name" / "Move name", button "Save as new library move" → `POST /coach/moves/fork-from-plan-move`, toast "Saved as new library move"). Both disabled until cue and why exist.
- Linked and in sync: check icon "In your library". The line "Edited since it was linked to your library" is removed from the drifted state (`ad1e9bf`); the two buttons say it.
- Name conflict: dialog `A move named "<name>" already exists` / "Overwrite replaces the library move's fields with this plan's copy." / "Overwrite it" (destructive) / "Cancel".

#### 7.3.8 Move picker (`MovePickerSheet`)

Full-height sheet "Add moves" with `GradusSheetHeader` "Close"; `GradusSearchField` "Search moves" (name, category, cue); grouped by category behind the same `CategoryHeader`s, which **start folded** (`7855ee6`): a **folded header shows how many of its moves are picked** (mono caption Bold `accentInk`), a typed search opens every category and header taps are then ignored (`picker.section.<category>`); multi-select rows with a **`PenCheckbox(Circle, 22)`** (seed = the move name's character count), name, "<target>[ · <cue>]"; pinned button "Choose moves" (disabled) → "Add 1 move" / "Add *n* moves" → "Adding…". `POST /plans/{id}/moves/from-library {moveIds}` (or the athlete route), then reload the plan. Coach empty library: "Your move library is empty. Tap New move to make one: it's saved to your library and added to this plan." (iOS #129). For a coach the sheet also has **"New move"** above the search and **"Create “<query>”"** under it (§7.3.8a B); an athlete's authoring picker has neither. Needs the network (new plan-move ids come from the server).

#### 7.3.8a New move and Draft with AI (#53)

Decision #53 and the same TestFlight feedback (2026-10-11: "too much friction as a coach to create new moves when generating a plan … only pull from library"; "add AI drafting support for new move creation"). iOS #129 at `fd78810`: `FeaturePlans/Components/MoveForm.swift` (`MoveFormValues`, `MoveFormModel`, `MoveFormFields`, `DraftedCaption`), `MoveSheet.swift` (`MoveSheet`, `MovePickerSheet`, `NewPlanMoveView`), `PlanDetailModel.swift` ("New move from the plan builder"), `GradusCore/Plans/PlanModels.swift` (`MoveDraftRequest`, `MoveDraft`, `MoveDraftSource`, `MoveRecognition`), `PlansRepository.swift` (`draftMove`). Web #224. Priorities follow iOS §7.3: **New move from the plan editor P0**, **AI drafts P1**. Both are **coach only**: athletes have no personal library, so the athlete authoring editor gets neither (§6.14.4).

**A. One shared form.** `MoveFormFields` (Compose) and `MoveFormViewModel`, the port of `MoveFormModel` (`MoveFormValues` stays a plain data class, so the fill rules are pure, JVM-tested functions). The Move library's `MoveSheet` (§7.3.3) and the plan builder's New move page both use them, so the two never drift. Fields, top to bottom:
1. **Name**: placeholder "Name this move" (library, new) / "Add a name" (library, edit) / "Name the move" (plan builder).
2. **Sport** and **Category**, side by side (they stack at `LocalIsAccessibilitySize`), as **unboxed `GradusMenuPicker`s** flush with their eyebrow labels (`7855ee6`, `1a507b5`: a long category wrapped to three lines and spilled past a fixed box). Sport has the placeholder "Sport". Category's first item is "Choose…", or "Type one below" when there are no options. With no category picked, a text field "e.g. Forehand, Footwork, Strength" (TalkBack label "New category") is shown. The category options for a sport are the coach's library categories plus the seeded curriculum categories (`seedCategories`) for that sport. Sports are compared trimmed, lower-cased, with spaces → `_`. Empty values are dropped and the list is sorted (`MoveLibrary.categoryOptions(sport:)`).
3. **Target**: the **`TargetStepper`** (§8.6.6), "− 10 reps +", tap the unit for minutes.
4. **One draft card** (`GradusCard`, padding 14; handoff "one card holding Draft with AI with the cue, why and description it fills in"):
   - the **Draft controls**, only when `canDraft` (coach): see C;
   - **Cue** "One line the athlete can repeat to themselves" (1–3 lines);
   - **Why this matters** "What this move develops, in plain language" (1–3 lines);
   - **Description** "How to perform the move, step by step" (2–6 lines).

A field the AI filled carries **no visible caption** for cue, why and description (`ad1e9bf`: "There are no 'Drafted by AI' captions"). Instead, its TalkBack action label says "Drafted by AI. Check it before saving." while the field still holds exactly the drafted text. **Category keeps its visible `DraftedCaption`** at `c8f83d6` (*code wins*). See D.

**B. New move from the plan builder** (`NewPlanMoveView`, `PlanDetailModel` "New move from the plan builder"). `canCreateMoves = canEdit && !isAuthoring`.
- **Editor button.** The coach's button reads **"Add moves"**, with the TalkBack hint "Pick moves from your library, or make a new one.". It was "Add moves from move library". The athlete's still reads "Add moves from the library", with no hint.
- **Picker** (`MovePickerSheet`, §7.3.8), coach only, when `canCreateMoves`:
  - **"New move"** (secondary button, plus icon) above the search field. TalkBack hint: "Make a move, save it to your library, and add it to this plan." It opens the New move page with an empty name.
  - **"Create “<query>”"**: a row under the search field (filled plus icon, bold text, ≥ 48 dp, TalkBack hint "Opens a new move with this name."). It is shown when the trimmed query is non-empty and **no** library move's trimmed name equals it, ignoring case. A partial match ("Waltz" with "Waltz jump" in the library) still offers it (`MovePickerSheet.offersCreate`, test `thePickerOffersCreateOnlyWhenTheSearchNamesNoLibraryMove`). It opens the New move page with the trimmed query as the name.
  - **Empty library (coach):** "Your move library is empty. Tap New move to make one: it's saved to your library and added to this plan." The "New move" button stays above it.
- **New move page.** iOS pushes it inside the picker's `NavigationStack`. Android shows it as a second page **inside the same full-height `ModalBottomSheet`**: an `AnimatedContent` or nested `NavHost` destination with a top bar titled "New move" and a back arrow (content description "Back"). System or predictive back returns to the picker, not out of the sheet. Leaving discards the form, as on iOS. Under the scrolling form, a pinned primary button **"Save to library & add"** ("Saving…" while saving), TalkBack hint "Saves the move to your library and adds it to this plan.". It is enabled only when the trimmed name and the sport are both non-empty, nothing is saving, and no draft is running. **Category is not required** here.
- **Prefill** (`newMoveValues(name:)`; everything but the name, so the coach types one thing):
  - **Sport:** the plan athlete's roster sport (`AthleteOption.sport`, from `GET /coach/roster` `athletes[].sport`). If that is missing, the sport most of this plan's library-linked moves use (`mostCommon`: most frequent non-empty value, ties to the first seen). Then the coach's first sport (`roster.coachSports`, newly loaded by the editor in `loadOptions`). Then the first library move's sport. Then "".
  - **Category:** the category this plan's library moves use most in that sport, else the first category option for the sport, else "". It is picked when it is one of the options; otherwise it goes into the typed field.
  - **Target:** Reps, "10".
  - **Sport options:** the coach's sports ∪ the library's sports ∪ the athlete's sport, non-empty, sorted, plus the current value.
- **Save** (`newMoveInput(from:)`, `createMoveAndAdd`). `PUT /coach/moves` `[idem]` with a fresh key and body `{sport, category: <resolved, or "Uncategorized" when blank>, name: <trimmed>, description, cue, why (each trimmed), defaultTargetKind, defaultTargetValue}`.
  - Saved → the move is put into the in-memory library, then `POST /plans/{id}/moves/from-library {moveIds:[id]}` `[idem]` with a fresh key. That **closes the picker**, reloads the plan and **expands the newly added row(s)**. Toast: "Saved to your library and added".
  - The upsert fails → toast `userMessage`, and the page stays.
  - The add fails after a successful save → toast "<name> is saved to your library but wasn't added to this plan. Pick it from the list to add it.".
  - **Online only, never queued** (new ids come from the server).
- **Same name** (the upsert's conflict reply). An M3 `AlertDialog` with vertically stacked full-width buttons (as in §7.3.6). Title: `A move named "<name>" is already in your library`. Text: "Add the existing one puts your library's move in this plan. Overwrite replaces its fields with these. Keep both saves this one as a second move.". Buttons:
  - "Add the existing one" → `POST .../moves/from-library` with that id; closes the picker and expands the row.
  - "Overwrite it" (destructive) → re-save with `overwriteMoveId`.
  - "Keep both" → re-save as "<name> (2)" with no `overwriteMoveId`; the server checks names on every insert.
  - "Cancel".
- **Library sheet** (`MoveSheet`, §7.3.3) is unchanged except for the shared form, Draft with AI, and **Save disabled while a draft runs**. Its own same-name dialog keeps "Overwrite it" / "Keep both" / "Cancel".

**C. Draft with AI: the control and the call.**
- **Button.** A Gradus chip with the sparkles icon (`Icons.Outlined.AutoAwesome`, decorative), label **"Draft with AI"**. While drafting it reads **"Drafting…"**, with a small `CircularProgressIndicator` in place of the icon. Target ≥ 48 dp; it follows font scale. It is enabled when `canDraft`, the trimmed name is non-empty, a sport is set and no draft is running. TalkBack hint: "Name the move and pick a sport first." when the name or sport is missing; otherwise "Suggests a description, cue and why for the empty fields. You can edit them before saving.".
- **Tap.** When description, cue and why are **all** non-blank, nothing is sent yet: an M3 `AlertDialog` asks first.
  - Title "Replace with an AI draft?"
  - Text "Your cue, why and description are all filled in. The draft would replace them."
  - Confirm "Replace" → draft with `replacing = true`. Dismiss "Keep mine" → nothing.
  - Otherwise the tap drafts with `replacing = false`.
- **Request.** `POST /api/v1/coach/moves/draft`, operation `draftMove`, through the **generated client**. It writes nothing, so there is no `Idempotency-Key`, it never goes through the outbox, and it is **never queued**. Body:
  ```json
  {"name":"<trimmed name>","sport":"<sport key>","category":"<resolved category, trimmed; omitted when empty>",
   "hint":"<trimmed hint, first 200 characters; omitted when empty>",
   "existing":{"description":"<as typed>","cue":"<as typed>","why":"<as typed>"}}
  ```
  `existing` is always sent (empty strings included), so the draft stays consistent with what the coach wrote. Server limits: name ≤ 160, sport ≤ 64, category ≤ 64, hint ≤ 200, existing description ≤ 2000, cue and why ≤ 1000.
- **Response** (200): `{description, cue, why, category?, source?, sourceName?, recognition?, understoodAs?}`. `source` ∈ `gradus_library` | `exercise_list` | `ai`; `recognition` ∈ `known` | `unsure` | `unknown`. The app reads **only** `recognition`, and `source` only to leave Gradus library text unmarked. `sourceName` and `understoodAs` are for logs and evals and are **never shown**. A missing `recognition` means `known` (a server from before the recognition check). A missing `source` counts as AI-written. `category` comes back only when the request had none. Android decodes `source` and `recognition` as `String?` (§4.3 rule 6). A value outside the enums is handled exactly as iOS handles an undecodable reply: nothing is filled and the generic failure copy is shown (see F).
- **Timeout (Android-native).** The server gives a draft up to 28 s (`DRAFT_BUDGET_MS`), inside the iOS app's 60-second URLSession request timeout. OkHttp's default read timeout is 10 s, so `draftMove` must run with a **60 s read and call timeout**: a per-call override, or a `newBuilder()` client for this operation. Verify against the shared client's settings in §6.2.
- **In flight.** Save is disabled on both containers while drafting (`canSave` includes `!isDrafting`). Typing continues. The fill is applied to the values **as they are when the reply lands**, so anything typed meanwhile stays. If the trimmed name or the sport changed while the call ran, the reply describes another move: it **fills nothing and shows nothing** (`aDraftThatReturnsAfterARenameFillsNothing`). The call runs in the sheet's ViewModel scope. A cancellation (the sheet closed) is never an error and never shows copy (`ApiError.isCancellation`).

**D. The fill rules** (`MoveFormValues.apply`, pure):
- An unrecognised draft (`unsure` or `unknown`) fills **nothing**, not even a category. See E.
- **Description, cue, why:** for each, a non-blank suggestion (trimmed) goes in only when the field is blank, or in every field when `replacing`. **Never** over what the coach typed otherwise (`theDraftFillsOnlyEmptyFieldsAndMarksThem`).
- **Category:** only when no category is picked **or** typed. A suggestion matching an option (ignoring case) is **picked**; otherwise it goes into the typed field. A picked category is never replaced, not even by Replace.
- **The mark.** For AI-written text (`source != "gradus_library"`), the filled value is remembered per field (`aiValues`). The field reads as drafted **only while it still holds exactly that text**, so the mark clears the moment the coach edits it (`editingADraftedFieldClearsItsMark`); for Category, the moment the picked or typed category changes. Gradus library text (`source == "gradus_library"`) fills **unmarked** and clears any earlier mark on that field (`gradusLibraryTextFillsUnmarked`). Exercise-list text is AI-written and **is** marked (`exerciseListDraftsAreMarkedAsAI`). The marks are form state only: they are never saved, so they are gone once the sheet closes on Save and never appear when a saved move is reopened in "Edit move". Nothing in the app ever says where a draft came from.
- **`DraftedCaption`** (Category only since `ad1e9bf`; cue, why and description carry the same words as their TalkBack action label instead): the sparkles icon (decorative) and **"Drafted by AI — check it"**, caption size, bold, `text-secondary`. It is in words, not colour alone. TalkBack reads the whole node as "The <field> was drafted by AI. Check it before saving.", with <field> ∈ "description", "cue", "why this matters", "category".
- **After a recognised draft:** the unrecognised state and the hint clear, then:
  - nothing filled → caption **"Every field already has your words, so nothing changed."** (also announced);
  - AI-written → announce "Drafted by AI: <fields>. Check it before saving.";
  - library → announce "Filled in: <fields>.".
  <fields> lists the filled fields in the order description, cue, why this matters, category, joined with ", ".

**E. Not recognised** (`recognition` is `unsure` or `unknown`; the server returns 200 with empty fields and **never invents a draft**). Nothing is filled. The form remembers the (name, sport) it was not recognised for, and shows an inline box under the Draft button **instead of** the caption. It is not a snackbar or toast; a card with a divider border, 12 dp padding. It contains:
- Text: **"Gradus doesn't recognise “<name>” in <Sport label>. Add a few words about it and draft again."**, where <Sport label> = `CoachSports.displayLabel`, for example "Figure Skating" (`unrecognisedMessage`; test text "Gradus doesn't recognise “Fizzle step” in Figure Skating. Add a few words about it and draft again."). It is announced when the reply lands, through a polite live region.
- Field labelled **"A few words about this move"**, placeholder **"e.g. a backward entry into a sit spin"**, 1–3 lines, IME action Done. Input stops at **200 characters** (longer input is truncated, including a paste). TalkBack hint: "Up to 200 characters. Then choose Draft again.".
- Chip **"Draft again"** (sparkles icon; "Drafting…" with a spinner while running; ≥ 48 dp). It is enabled only when the draft button would be enabled **and** the trimmed hint is non-empty. TalkBack hint: "Drafts the empty fields using your words." when enabled, else "Add a few words about the move first.". It sends the same request with `hint` and still fills only empty fields. With the hint, the server may treat the move as known and stays consistent with it.
- The box shows only while the form still holds the same trimmed name **and** sport. Renaming the move or changing the sport hides it; restoring both shows it again (`renamingTheMoveOrChangingTheSportClearsTheMessage`).

**F. Offline and errors** (`MoveFormModel.message(for:)`; friendly copy for every failure and **never the transport text**). The copy shows as the caption under the button and is announced. Nothing is filled and the button re-enables.

| Failure | Copy (verbatim) |
|---|---|
| `offline` or `unreachable` (status 0) | "AI drafting needs a connection. Try again when you're back online." |
| 429 or code `rate_limited` (server: 30 drafts per hour per coach, library matches included, shared with the web, `Retry-After`) | "That's a lot of drafts for one hour. Try again a little later." |
| Anything else: 503 `ai_unavailable` (no model answered within the 28 s budget), 404 (a server published before web #224), 422 (`unprocessable`: empty name or sport, or a sport that isn't a key), 403, a decode failure | "AI drafting isn't available right now." |
| Cancellation | nothing |

**[code wins], kept for parity (A2), see §12 N74:** while the unrecognised box is showing, a failed "Draft again" sets the caption, but iOS draws the box instead of the caption. The failure is therefore only announced to VoiceOver, not shown. Android copies this unless Mariah takes N74.

**G. What the server does (inherited, nothing on the client).** Lookup order:
1. the Gradus library: a `seed_moves` match by normalised name answers in its own words, with no AI call;
2. the open exercise list, facts only;
3. the recognition check on Claude Haiku 5.5 with web search (at most 3 searches), with Gemini 2.5 Flash on the Lovable gateway as the fallback.

Other inherited rules: one 28 s budget; coach only (403 for parents and athletes); writes nothing; rate limit 30 per hour per coach. The device never calls a model vendor (§6.7.1).

**H. Accessibility** (§8.5). All targets ≥ 48 dp. Labels and hints as above. The inline box, the caption and the announcements use a polite live region on a node that holds the same words. The two "Drafted by AI: …" and "Filled in: …" announcements have no visible text, so they use a visually hidden polite live-region node. `announceForAccessibility` is deprecated, so verify on API 36, as §7.2.10 notes. Text grows with font scale with nothing truncated, and Sport and Category stack at `LocalIsAccessibilitySize`. The caption is never colour-only.

**I. Analytics.** No new event (iOS #129 adds none). Time spent in the move sheet, the picker and the New move page counts toward the `plans` area (§6.12).

**J. Offline summary.** Draft with AI, Save to library & add, and Add the existing one need a connection and are never queued (§7.3.11, §6.5). Library-sheet Save keeps its existing behaviour (§7.3.3).

**K. Tests.** Port `NewMoveTests` and `MoveDraftTests` case for case (JUnit 5 + Turbine against `FakePlansRepository`, the `PreviewPlansRepository` port). The fake mirrors the iOS preview `draftMove`:
- a figure-skating library name answers with that seed move's own text (`source = gradus_library`, category only when none was given);
- "Romanian Deadlift", "Goblet Squat", "Split Squat", "Plank" and "Box Jump" answer as the exercise list;
- a name containing "zz" is `unknown` until a non-blank hint is given;
- anything else gets a sport-flavoured `ai` draft whose cue is "Smooth first, then strong".

The fake also has `delayMs` for the in-flight test.
- `NewMoveTests`: `thePickerOffersCreateOnlyWhenTheSearchNamesNoLibraryMove`, `createFromTheSearchOpensTheFormWithThatName`, `everythingButTheNameIsPrefilledFromThePlan`, `withoutAnAthleteSportTheSportComesFromThePlansMoves`, `anEmptyPlanFallsBackToTheCoachsFirstSportAndItsFirstCategory`, `aBlankCategorySavesAsUncategorizedSoOnlyTheNameIsRequired` ("12,5" → 12.5), `saveToLibraryAndAddUpsertsThenAddsTheNewMoveToThisPlan` (upsert before add, the new row expanded, the picker closed), `aSameNamedMoveIsAConflictAndNothingIsAddedUntilTheCoachChooses`, `theDraftFillsOnlyEmptyFieldsAndMarksThem`, `aDraftThatReturnsAfterARenameFillsNothing`, `editingADraftedFieldClearsItsMark`, `withEveryFieldWrittenItAsksBeforeReplacing` (no call until Replace), `aDraftNeedsANameAndASport`, `failuresReadAsFriendlyCopyNeverTheTransportText` (503, 404, offline, 429), `gradusLibraryTextFillsUnmarked`, `exerciseListDraftsAreMarkedAsAI`, `anUnknownMoveFillsNothingAndAsksForAFewWords` (Draft again sends nothing without a hint; the hint is cleared after a recognised draft), `renamingTheMoveOrChangingTheSportClearsTheMessage`, `applyingAnUnrecognisedDraftFillsNothing`, `athletesGetNeitherNewMovesNorAIDrafts` (no `upsertMove` or `draftMove` recorded), `aCoachsLibrarySheetCanDraftButAnAthleteGraphCannot`.
- `MoveDraftTests`: `theDraftOperationIsInTheContract` (vendored `openapi.json` has `POST /api/v1/coach/moves/draft`, `operationId` `draftMove`), `aReplyWithoutACategoryDecodes`, `thePreviewDraftIsSportFlavouredAndSuggestsACategoryOnlyWhenNoneWasGiven`, `aReplyFromBeforeTheRecognitionCheckReadsAsKnownAndAIWritten`, `theNewOptionalFieldsDecode`, `theLiveMappingCarriesTheHintAndTheRecognition`, `aFigureSkatingLibraryNameAnswersWithThatMovesOwnText`, `aGymNameAnswersAsTheOpenExerciseList`, `aNameWithZZIsUnknownUntilTheCoachAddsAHint`.
- Android additions:
  - a MockWebServer reply delayed 30 s still succeeds (timeout);
  - an unknown `recognition` or `source` value fills nothing and shows "AI drafting isn't available right now.";
  - the hint field truncates a 250-character paste to 200;
  - predictive back on the New move page returns to the picker;
  - Compose UI and screenshot tests for each state (idle, drafting, drafted with captions, unrecognised box, each failure caption, the replace dialog, the same-name dialog) at default and 200 % font scale, in both themes;
  - TalkBack reads the caption labels and the live-region messages.

**L. QA rows** (`docs/android/QA.md`; iOS QA.md has none for #53 yet).
- Coach: in a plan, Add moves → New move → type a name → Draft with AI fills the empty fields with "Drafted by AI — check it"; editing one clears its caption; Save to library & add puts it in the plan, expanded.
- "Forward crossovers" in Figure Skating fills unmarked.
- A made-up name shows the "Gradus doesn't recognise…" box; a hint and Draft again fill it.
- In airplane mode: the connection message.
- An athlete's editor shows no New move and no Draft with AI.

#### 7.3.9 Shared plans (`/p/:token`) and adoption (#35)

`SharedPlanScreen` (route `SharedPlan(token)`, App Link `https://gradus.training/p/{token}`, §6.10; top bar "Shared plan"):
- Loads `GET /public/plans/{token}`; error: state view "Couldn't open this plan", message, "Try again".
- Eyebrow attribution: "Plan by Coach *First Last*" / "Plan by a Gradus coach" (no name) / "Plan by *first name*" (athlete author) / "Plan by an athlete"; page title; notes; a card per move: name, "<n> reps" / "<n> min", description, cue (quote icon), why.
- Import button by role: coach "Save to my library" ("Saving…") → toast "Saved to your library as a template"; athlete "Add to my plans" ("Adding…") with caption "This adds a copy to your plans, ready to practice. Changes you make stay yours." → toast "Added to your plans"; parent: no button. `POST /plans/import/{token}` `[idem]` → `{planId}` → open `Plan(planId)` (an athlete's copy is active, so it opens in the runner).
- An author athlete who is paused: the link no longer resolves (server).

**Share from the coach editor:** see 7.3.4 (Publish & Share / top-bar Share). Share payload identical to §6.14.4.

#### 7.3.10 Figure skating move catalog

`GradusCore/Plans/FigureSkatingMoves.swift` (`FigureSkatingMoveSeed`, 275 moves, 43 categories, the 2026-09-12 export of the production seed) is **fixture data only** on iOS: it backs `PreviewPlansRepository.previewLibrary` for previews, the mock graph, tests and App Store screenshots. Real coaches and athletes get the server's `seed_moves` (coach library seeding; `GET /athlete/moves`). Android: export the Swift array once to `core/data/src/testFixtures/resources/figure-skating-moves.json` (not under `Contract/`, which `sync-contract.sh` overwrites) (script, never retyped; same ids, e.g. `fs-forward-stroking`), load it in `FakePlansRepository` and screenshot tests, and **never** ship it as a runtime source of curriculum. Category strings are kept as exported, including the near-duplicate "Off Ice" / "Off ice" (that is the production data).

| Works fully offline (cache) | Queues offline | Needs network |

| Plans lists per filter, library, last 20 plan details | Title, notes, assignment to an athlete or Public (not a fork), move field edits, target, reorder, remove (with reason), status changes (with reason and `replaceId`), **delete from the list** (Drafts/Benched/Templates, `PlansListModel`), archive | **Delete from the editor** (coach or athlete: no outbox fallback, error toast, editor stays open; `PlanDetailModel.delete()`), create plan/template, add moves from library, save/update/fork library moves, upsert move, share link, import, the active-plans read of the 409 bench-choice fallback (#52), AI summary, **Draft with AI** (#53; never queued), **New move → "Save to library & add"** and "Add the existing one" (#53; never queued), voice (parked, §7.4), fork-on-reassign |

All test names above map one-to-one to JUnit tests; key expectations: list filters and ETag reuse; how-to bubble rules; delete allowed on Drafts/Benched/Templates and refused (row restored) for active; queued delete/archive drop ETags; library groups and searches; upsert conflict; moves expand only for drafts; unassigned draft blocker and dashed empty box; Public reopens as Public; refused assignment clears the pick; field edits apply locally and reach the repository; no cap (#52): with two others active, Activate goes straight through with no active-plans read and all three stay active (`activatingWithTwoOthersActiveGoesStraightThrough`); a 409 `bench_choice_required` opens the bench choice with every other active plan and nothing preselected, and a pick benches that plan (`anUnpublishedServersBenchChoiceIsTheFallback`); a 409 with nothing to offer is the server's message as a toast, not an empty sheet (`aBenchChoiceWithNothingToOfferIsAToast`); a repeated 409 swaps a fresh list in place and clears the pick (`aRepeated409KeepsTheSheetOpenWithAFreshList`); the fake repository has no cap, and a `replaceId` that is not another of the athlete's active plans benches nothing while the activation still goes through (`noActivePlanCapAndTheDeleteRuleMatchTheServer`); New move and Draft with AI per §7.3.8a; offline edits queue; explicit null on unassign; voice touched merge until "Looks good"; stashed highlights reach the editor once; template spawns a draft; `new:` placeholder redirects; pending voice file names parse (`<mode>__<planId|new>__<epoch>.m4a`); why prompt send/skip/queue rules; labels "Goal reached", "On hold", "No longer needed" and their detail lines with fallbacks; `{"status":"benched"}` when skipped and `{"reason":"changed_direction","status":"benched"}` when answered; every transport write path exists in the vendored contract.
