### 7.4 Coach — voice

| Feature | Web today | iOS 1.0 (reference) | Android requirement | Pri |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Voice → plan (create) | Voice FAB on Plans: record ≤ 90 s, ElevenLabs transcription, AI builds a full plan, AI-touched fields highlighted | Mic button above the "+" FAB on the Plans segment (`FeaturePlans/PlansListView.swift`) | Mic FAB (56 dp, accent) stacked above the "New plan" FAB on the **Plans** segment only (not on Move library). Same flow as below. | P0 |
| Voice edit of an open plan | Same FAB in edit mode | Inline 36 dp mic in the plan editor's top bar, next to Share, shown when `canEdit` and voice is available (`PlanDetailView.swift`) | Mic `IconButton` (48 dp touch target) in the plan editor's top app bar actions, after Share, when the plan is editable. Coaches always; athletes only with `athleteVoiceToPlan == true` (§6.14) | P0 |
| Voice notes in messages | Push-to-talk, playback with progress | See iOS §7.5 | See §7.5 (format and upload in §6.7.3, playback in §6.7.6) | P0 |
| Voice on the wrist (voice → plan, wrap-up by voice) | — | §7.15 | §7.15 | P0 |

#### 7.4.1 Interaction (code at HEAD wins)

The iOS PRD row and iOS QA §3 say "hold to record, cancel by slide". **The iOS code at HEAD is tap-to-start, tap "Stop & organize" to send, and an X to cancel** (`FeaturePlans/Components/VoiceCaptureButton.swift`); there is no press-and-hold gesture, no slide-to-cancel and no recording haptic. Android follows the code.

1. **Tap the mic.** The editor's inline mic (top bar) is **outlined at rest** (`card` fill, 1 dp `textSecondary` ring, `accentInk` icon) and **lime only while listening or processing**, so lime on it signals a state, not an action (§8.6.2). The Plans-list voice FAB stays lime (*code wins*, §12 N93). First use asks for `RECORD_AUDIO` in context. Denied (including permanently denied, when Android no longer shows the prompt) → error snackbar "Allow microphone access in Settings to dictate plans." (iOS `VoiceCaptureButton`) with an action **"Settings"** that opens `Settings.ACTION_APPLICATION_DETAILS_SETTINGS` for the app (the Android-native equivalent of pointing at iOS Settings), and nothing else happens. Granted → recording starts and a full-screen overlay opens (Compose `Dialog` with `usePlatformDefaultWidth = false`, scrim black 45 %, card anchored at the bottom).
2. **Recording overlay (card on the opaque `popover` surface, radius 24 dp, `borderStrong` border, 16 dp margin + 24 dp extra bottom):**
   - Header: a 48 dp accent circle with the mic icon whose outer ring grows with the input level (stroke = level × 14 dp, accent at 30 %); title **"Listening…"** (display font, title2); beneath it a 7-bar waveform (2 dp bars, height `12 dp × max(0.15, level × (1 − 0.35·p²))` for p = (i−3)/3, `accentInk`, 100 ms linear animation) and the elapsed time as `m:ss` (mono, caption); an **X** button (label "Cancel") on the trailing edge.
   - Guidance box (elevated at 70 %, radius `lg`): eyebrow **"TRY SAYING"** (mono, bold, tracked), then three "›" bullets:
     - create: "Your athlete's name" / "The moves you want them to work on" / "Why you're assigning this now"
     - edit: "Edits to a specific move" / "Add or remove a move" / "Update notes and cues"
     - (athlete authoring, §6.14: create "The moves you want to work on" / "How many reps or how many minutes" / "A cue to remember for each move"; edit "Add a move and how many" / "Change a move's reps or minutes" / "Update your notes and cues"; no privacy line since iOS #134)
   - Stop row: the chip button **"Stop & organize"** alone. The line "Tap stop when done." is gone (`ad1e9bf`). At accessibility font sizes (`fontScale ≥ 1.5`, the one threshold in §7.13.7 and §8.1) the header stacks vertically, the stop row stacks with a full-width primary "Stop & organize", and the card scrolls when taller than the screen (WCAG 1.4.4, 1.4.10).
   - After 75 s: a bold destructive-ink warning **"Wrapping up at 1:30"** with an alert icon.
   - At 90 s the recorder stops itself; the overlay stays until the coach taps "Stop & organize", which sends what was recorded (iOS behavior; the phone does not auto-send). X discards.
3. **Processing:** the mic button shows a progress indicator and is disabled; the overlay header shows a neutral circle with a spinner, title **"Organizing your plan…"**, and the mono caption **"TRANSCRIBING & PARSING WITH AI"**. Clips under 1 s are dropped silently. The X is hidden.
4. **Send:** `POST /voice/build-plan` with `audio` (`voice.m4a`, `audio/mp4`), `mode`, `planId` (edit), a fresh `Idempotency-Key`.
5. **Result snackbar** (iOS `VoiceCaptureModel.outcomeToast`, verbatim; kinds map to the snackbar styles in §8):

| Result | Create | Edit | Kind |
|---|---|---|---|
| `aiFailed` | "We couldn't turn that dictation into a plan. Your words are saved on the plan — open it to add moves, or try again." | "We couldn't turn that dictation into changes. Your words are saved on the plan — try again, or edit by hand." | error |
| `appliedMoveCount == 0` | "Couldn't pick out moves from that — your dictation is saved on the plan so you can add moves manually." | "Couldn't pick out moves from that — your dictation is saved on the plan." | info |
| success | "New plan from voice · <n> moves" ("1 move") | "Updated · <n> moves" | success |
| success with `droppedMoveCount > 0` | base + " · one move we couldn't read was skipped" or " · <n> moves we couldn't read were skipped" | same | info |
| `unresolvedAthleteName` present (extra snackbar) | "Couldn't find \"<name>\" in your roster" | same | default |
| server refusal | the server's message (§6.7.3 table) | same | error |

6. **Navigation after create:** stash the result's `touched` for the new plan id (Android `VoiceTouchedStash`: an in-memory map in the plans feature's `@ActivityRetainedScoped` holder; `put(planId, touched)`, `take(planId)` removes), refresh the list, open the plan editor; the editor takes the stash on first composition (iOS `VoiceTouchedStash.swift`, web `voice-touched-store.ts`). **After edit:** merge the new `touched` into the editor's current highlights, reload the plan, and reload practice sessions if the plan is active (iOS `PlanDetailModel.applyVoice`).

#### 7.4.2 AI-touched highlights in the editor (diffs preserved)

- **No banner and no "Looks good"** (`ad1e9bf`). While any highlight remains, the plan header shows **"N changes"** (subheadline Bold; action label "Each changed move is tagged New or Changed. Tweak anything, then share to keep them."), and **sharing the plan accepts them**: the primary (Activate & Share, Update & Share, Publish & Share) clears every highlight.
- Each touched field (title, notes, athlete assignment, and per-move name / description / cue / why / target): text on `attentionWash` with a 2 dp `penOrange` underline. If the field has a source quote, its label row shows a text button **"From your voice"** that toggles to **"Hide source"** and reveals the quote in curly quotes (“…”), italic caption, on `elevated`.
- Assignment card: when the athlete was set by voice, its quote shows in italic `accentInk` caption under the athlete and the card background is `attentionWash`.
- **Collapsed move rows** of a new or touched move carry a **change tag** (§8.6.8): "New" (tennis) for an added move, "Reps"/"Minutes" when the target changed, "Changed" otherwise. The name itself is no longer washed.
- **Talk it through** (the plan building live while the coach talks, each landing move with the EditingOutline, a pen check, and the "just changed" underline on the newest) is **mock-only on iOS** (`LivePlanPreview` behind `-GradusDemoVoiceLive`). It is not built until the voice API streams moves (§12 N95).
- Editing a highlighted field by hand clears that field's highlight (iOS `touched.clearPlan("title")` etc.).
- **"What you dictated"** expandable section (after notes, before Assign to) whenever the plan has `voiceTranscript`: shows the transcript (no privacy caption since iOS #134).

#### 7.4.3 Offline and retry (iOS §7.4 "audio saved locally first")

- **Coach, no connection** (connectivity monitor says offline, or the send fails with status 0): park the clip in `noBackupFilesDir/pending-voice/` named `<mode>__<planId|new>__<epochSeconds>.m4a` and show "You're offline — your recording is saved and the draft will appear when you're back online." Parked files are app-private (credential-encrypted storage).
- **Drain** when the Plans list appears and on every return to the foreground while online: send each parked file in name order. Success → delete it, snackbar "Your dictated plan is ready." (create) or "Your dictated changes were applied." (edit), stash `touched`, open the plan. Network failure, 5xx, an expired session or 403 `ai_consent_required` → keep it and stop for now. The drain runs only while AI features are allowed (§6.7.1a), and once more as soon as permission turns on. Any other refusal → delete it and show the server's message.
- **Idempotency (open decision, §12 N34):** iOS at HEAD uses a fresh key on the live send and `voice-<filename>` on the parked retry, so a lost response can duplicate the plan; the live send shows the server's message as an error snackbar on 409 `idempotency_key_reused`; and its drain deletes a parked file on 409/429 (`VoiceCaptureButton.swift`). handoff-2026-10-05 §5 item 2 records the fix as owed on iOS. **Default under A2: copy iOS exactly.** The proposed fix — store the original `Idempotency-Key` alongside the parked clip and reuse it on every retry, treat 409 `idempotency_key_reused` as success (refresh and open), keep the file on 409 `idempotency_key_in_progress` and 429 — is §12 N34 for Mariah, to land on iOS and Android together so the two stay identical.
- **Drain runs only in the coach graph's own folder**; the athlete editor never parks (§6.14: "We couldn't reach Gradus, so your recording wasn't kept. Check your connection and dictate again."). A coach clip parked on a device must never be sent under an athlete login: the folder is per user id and is wiped on sign-out.
- A WorkManager job is **not** used for voice drains (iOS drains only in the foreground with the Plans screen visible, so the coach sees the result); revisit post-1.0.

#### 7.4.4 Accessibility

- Mic button labels: iOS uses "Hold to dictate a new plan" / "Hold to add to plan by voice" for coaches, which no longer matches the tap interaction. Android uses **"Dictate a new plan"** / **"Add to this plan by voice"** for every role (the iOS athlete wording; proposed). Hints: "Starts recording" / "Stops the recording and builds the plan". Cancel: "Cancel". Elapsed time is a polite live region updated each second.
- The overlay reflows at large font scales (above); every control ≥ 48 dp; contrast per §8.
- The recorder and the narrator never run together (§6.7.4).

**§12 entries owed by this section:** (1) the phone voice idempotency fix above, to land with the matching iOS fix from handoff-2026-10-05 §5 item 2 (§12 N34); (2) legacy WebM voice-note playback on Android (A15, §6.7.6); (3) notification-shade pull-down not pausing a read on the phone (§12 N35); (4) the read-aloud gender table, preferred names and display names (§12 N10).

Test expectations: port the iOS `VoiceCaptureModel` tests (outcome snackbar wording for every branch, the unresolved-name snackbar, offline parking name format, drain success / keep / drop branches) plus the idempotency fix if Mariah accepts it; Compose UI tests for the overlay states (recording, > 75 s warning, processing) at 1.0× and 2.0× font scale; a Roborazzi/Paparazzi snapshot of each.
