You don't have to have the right words. Try something like:"`; then an italic quote card `"\"Something's been bugging me about practice and I don't really know how to explain it. Can we talk for a few minutes?\""` (with the literal quotation marks); then the footer `"If the first adult doesn't get it, try another one. That's not on you."`
5. **Gradus Support** card (S4, Guideline 1.2): title "Gradus Support"; body `"Something wrong in a Gradus conversation? Long-press the message and choose Report this message, or email us. Reporting doesn't notify the other person."` (the long-press gesture is the same on Android); `"Every report reaches our team the moment it's sent, and reports about a minor's safety are flagged urgent. We respond within one business day."`; chip `support@gradussports.com` → `mailto:` (`Intent.ACTION_SENDTO`), hint "Opens your email app"; `"Gradus isn't an emergency or reporting service for abuse. For that, use the hotlines below or call 911."`
6. **Talk to someone now** hotlines (`SafeSportHotlines`, eyebrow "Talk to someone now", id `safeSport.hotlines`), each a card with name (bold), hours (caption), blurb, then chips in this order: **Call <formatTel(tel)>** when `tel` is set, **Text <sms>** when `sms` is set, and **Website** on **every** hotline (hint `"Opens in your browser"`, iOS "Opens in Safari"). Content, verbatim (`SafeSportContent.hotlines`):

   | id | name | blurb | tel | sms | url | hours |
   |---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
   | `safesport` | U.S. Center for SafeSport | `"Specifically for sport. You can report something about a coach, teammate, or official — or just ask if something counts."` | `8663676272` | — | `https://uscenterforsafesport.org/report-a-concern/` | `"Online 24/7 · Phone Mon–Fri"` |
   | `childhelp` | Childhelp National Hotline | `"Trained counselors for anyone under 18 (or worried about someone under 18). Free, confidential, you don't have to give your name."` | `18004224453` | — | `https://www.childhelphotline.org/` | `"Call or text · 24/7"` |
   | `crisistext` | Crisis Text Line | `"If talking out loud feels like too much, text a trained counselor instead. They'll text back."` | — | `741741` | `https://www.crisistextline.org/` | `"Text HOME to 741741 · 24/7"` |
   | `988` | 988 Suicide & Crisis Lifeline | `"If you're in crisis — about anything, not only sport — call or text 988. You don't have to be in danger to use it."` | `988` | `988` | `https://988lifeline.org/` | `"Call or text · 24/7"` |

   Childhelp has **no Text chip** (`sms` is nil) even though its hours line says "Call or text"; keep it exactly so. Test tags `safeSport.call.<id>`, `safeSport.text.<id>`, `safeSport.website.<id>`. Phone numbers formatted with `formatTel` (11 digits starting 1 → `1-800-422-4453`, 10 → `866-367-6272`, else as given, so `988` stays `988`). Call → `Intent.ACTION_DIAL` (`tel:`; iOS `tel://`, which also asks before dialing), text → `ACTION_SENDTO` (`smsto:`), website → `ACTION_VIEW`. The same hotline block is reused by Ask Gradus safety answers (7.9.4). Footer lines `"These are independent services — not Gradus, and not your coach. What you share with them stays with them."` and `"If you or someone else is in immediate danger, call 911."`
7. **Safety exit** pill pinned bottom-end (ink on paper, ≥7:1 contrast both themes, ≥48 dp tall on Android, label "Safety exit", hint `"Leaves Gradus right away and opens a Google search page in your browser."`, hardware-keyboard Escape triggers it): first move state off Safe Sport (Resources segment → Library; Settings → pop the screen), then open `https://www.google.com/` with `ACTION_VIEW` in a new task. Like iOS it is fast, not forensic (the app stays in Recents).

Every external action announces that it leaves the app (QA.md §7). Analytics: `safe_sport_open` on appear (area `resources`, screen `safeSport`), nothing else.

#### 7.9.4 Ask Gradus (built, hidden in 1.0)

`AskGradusView.swift`, `AskAnswerContent.swift`, iOS §6.7 "Grounded Ask Gradus" (#15, #16).

- Sport comes from the root's shared sport picker (first feed sport by default); no sport → the no-sports message. Changing sport resets the card.
- **Composer** card: multi-line field (3–8 lines), placeholder `"Ask about a move, drill, or competition"` (parent/coach) or `"Ask about a move, drill, or your event"` (athlete audience), content description "Your question"; **Ask** button (sparkle icon) disabled while empty or asking; while asking `"Thinking…"` with a progress indicator. The question stays in the field after asking (matching the web); only "New question" clears it.
- `POST /ask {sport, question, audience}`; `audience` is fixed per caller (`parent` for coach and parent, `athlete` for athletes) and **always sent**. 429 → `"Too many attempts. Please wait a moment and try again."` (the shared `userMessage`). Errors appear in a destructive-tinted line (test tag `askGradus.error`) and are announced as `"Error: <message>"`; when the model has no specific message the fallback is `"Something went wrong asking Gradus."` (`AskGradusView.swift`).
- **Answer card**: the question with an accent rule; then `AskAnswerContent`: (1) `safety == true` → the **Safe Sport hotlines** first (7.9.3 item 6); (2) `fallbackNote`: when not grounded and not safety and the answer's first `\n\n` paragraph starts with `"This answer isn't drawn from Gradus sources"`, show that sentence as an info note (content description `"Note: …"`), never hidden, and render the rest as the body; (3) the body as Markdown (7.9.6); (4) **Sources** eyebrow and rows: index number, `titleLine` (`"Title (edition)"`), `locationLine` (`"section · page N"`); a row with `resourceId` opens the resource viewer as a PDF at that page (hint `"Opens the document at page N"`), with only `externalUrl` opens the browser, otherwise a plain non-tappable row; content description `"Source 1: Rules of Golf (2023), Rule 13.1, page 91"`.
- Footer: "New question" and **Save** (bookmark) → `"Saving"` → `"Saved"` (checkmark, disabled); saved state is per answer and resets on New question. Save posts `{sport, question, answer, sources, grounded, safety}` through the online-first/outbox path; toast `"Answer saved"`.
- Announce `"Answer ready"` or `"Answer ready, with people you can talk to"` (safety).
- Analytics: `ask_question{grounded, safety, sourceCount}` (never the question), `ask_answer_saved`, `ask_source_tap{index}`.
- Tests: port `SegmentVisibilityTests.swift` (flag off → nobody sees Ask/Saved, athletes keep Safe Sport; the shipped flag is `false`; adult athlete sees four; minor sees Library + Safe Sport; coach/parent segments never depend on `canAskGradus`), plus `fallbackNote`/`body` splitting and source-row behavior.

#### 7.9.5 Saved answers (built, hidden in 1.0)

`SavedAnswersListView.swift`: loaded on demand (`GET /saved-answers` → `{answers:[…]}`), **all sports** (each card names its sport, uppercase), newest first. Card: question (2 lines collapsed) and abbreviated date; expanding shows the full answer via `AskAnswerContent` (sources and safety panel kept; rows saved before L5 or on the web have unknown grounding and render as plain text) and **Remove** → confirm `"Remove this saved answer?"` / `"You can ask the question again any time."` with **Remove** / **Keep it**; `"Removing"` while in flight; toast `"Answer deleted"`. States: `"Loading saved answers…"`, `"Couldn't load saved answers"` + Try again, empty `"No saved answers yet. Tap Save on any Ask Gradus reply."`. Android: expandable cards (`AnimatedVisibility`, `stateDescription` "Expanded"/"Collapsed"), `AlertDialog`. **Not cached to disk** (code wins over iOS PRD §7.9 "cached offline": `ResourcesModel.savedAnswers` is in-memory only and only the feed is persisted to `resources.json`). Held in memory for the session, reloaded (`GET /saved-answers`) each time the Saved segment appears; offline shows `"Couldn't load saved answers"` + Try again. A save queued offline is inserted at the top with id `"pending-<uuid>"` until the next load replaces the list. Decoding tolerates missing `sources/grounded/safety`.

#### 7.9.6 Markdown rendering

Port `MarkdownText.swift` exactly (pure Kotlin parser + Compose renderer), not a general CommonMark library, so block splitting matches iOS's tests:

- Normalize `\r\n`/`\r`; fenced code first (```` ``` ```` or `~~~`, language hint, its blank lines don't split, closing fence optional); then blank-line groups classified by the first line: heading (`#`…`######` + space), list (`- `, `* `, `1. ` keeping the literal ordinal; a marker-less line joins the previous item), blockquote (`>` stripped, one block across lines), else paragraph lines joined by spaces, splitting off a heading/list/quote that follows with no blank line.
- Render: heading in display font (title3); list items with bullet `•` or ordinal; blockquote italic secondary with an accent rule; code in mono on the code-block surface tokens with the uppercase language label; paragraphs in body. 12 dp between blocks, 4 dp between list items.
- Inline (`**bold**`, `*italic*`/`_italic_`, `` `code` ``, `[text](url)`) → `AnnotatedString`; links in accent ink, underlined, `LinkAnnotation.Url` opening the browser; inline code in mono. Whole answer selectable (`SelectionContainer`).
- Tests: port all 13 `MarkdownTextTests.swift` cases.

(spoken "Total score", "Technical elements score", "Program components score", "Deductions"), **Executed elements** (`"Base = base value · GOE = grade of execution, the judges' quality adjustment"`, columns # / Element / Base / GOE / Score, Totals row), **Program components** (`"Each component's score, then the factor it is multiplied by for the total"`, `×factor`), **Deductions** (`−value`); score without protocol: cells SCORE / TOTAL (if different) / PLACE, `"The element-by-element protocol isn't included for this skate."`, "Official results" link (hint `"Opens the event on the U.S. Figure Skating results site"`); not scored: `NO SCORE POSTED` / `"No score was posted for this skate."` (final), `RESULTS PENDING` / `"Scores post a minute or two after each skate and show up here."` (live), `NOT SKATED YET` / `"Scheduled for <time>. Scores show up here as soon as they post."` or `"Scores show up here as soon as they post."` (scheduled).
- **Following tab** (`FollowingView.swift`): layout order, top to bottom: (Android only) the notification-permission card (6.9.6) → **My skaters** card → **Follow someone else** card → signed out: the sign-in card; signed in with nothing shown: the no-matches card. My skaters card (followed matches, or all matches when none followed; omitted when that set is empty), group header `"Your skater"` (one group) or `"Your skaters"` (more), grouped per skater: name (opens scores) and a **Follow/Unfollow** pill (description `"Stop following <name>"`/`"Follow <name>"`), then one row per event: title, state tag (accent on the group's accent row), `"meta · meta ›"`, changed-row wash; then **"Follow someone else"** card (collapsed row showing `SEARCH` or `"N ADDED"`; expanded: `FOLLOW A SKATER`, Close, field `"Search a skater's name"` (content description `"Search skaters competing today"`; ≥2 chars, case-insensitive contains, max 8 results), result rows (name + `"event · rink ›"` opening scores) with `Follow`/`Following` pills (tapping **Follow** clears the query; tapping **Following** unfollows and keeps the query; Close collapses the card and clears the query); `"No skater by that name on today's start orders."`; hint `"Type a name to follow anyone skating today. Saved on this device — no account needed."`; `"following A, B"`); the card is absent when the board has no skaters. Signed out: card `"Sign in to follow your skaters"` / `"The first time, match each of your athletes to their name on the board. After that, they show up here, with live updates while you use the app."` / **Sign in or sign up**. Signed in with no matches: `"None of your skaters are on today's start orders yet. Follow anyone below, or check the schedule."`
- Offline: within a session, the board keeps showing the last snapshot it holds with its age (the `Board` lives in memory in `BoardViewModel`, as iOS `BoardSession.board`). On a **cold launch offline**, there is no snapshot: the board shows the failed state (`"Couldn't load the board"` + offline message + **Try again**), matching iOS code. QA.md §7 ("Launch with no network: … the Live Board shows the last snapshot with its age") is stale against the code; §12 N64 (fix QA.md, or decide to persist the last `Board` per slug, which would be an Android addition). Android does not persist board payloads in 1.0.

#### 7.10.2 Competition results linking and post-event card (coach)

Endpoints: `GET /competitions/finished?athleteId=`, `POST /competitions/{id}/skater-matches {athleteId}`, `POST /athletes/{id}/competition-links {competitionId, skaterName, club, files[]}` → `{linked}`, `DELETE /athletes/{id}/competition-links/{competitionId}` (the link id **is** the competition id), `GET /athletes/{id}/competition-results`, `POST /athletes/{id}/competition-results/{competitionId}/generate-plan` → `{planId, title, moveCount}`, `GET /coach/post-event`, `POST /coach/post-event/{id}/dismiss`, `GET /coach/competitions/{id}/roster`. All writes are **online-only** (they depend on the server re-reading live external results; `CompetitionResultsModel.swift`). Models mirror `CompetitionResultsModels.swift`.

- **Athlete detail section** (`AthleteCompetitionResultsSection.swift` at `c8f83d6`; omitted for the sample athlete).
  - **Header:** `COMPETITIONS` (mono caption Bold, heading) + an outlined chip **Add** (`competitionResults.link`) that opens a `DropdownMenu`:
    - **"Find on the Live board"** (`sensors`), which opens the linking sheet; skating only, because the board only knows figure skating;
    - **"Enter results"** (`edit_note`), for any sport (*mock-only on iOS*, §12 N96).
  - **Empty:** a dashed box, "No competitions linked yet.". **Error:** the error text.
  - **Each link is one tappable row** (borderless card):
    - the competition name (display title3) and "`event` · `dates`" (caption);
    - at the end, **the placing as the hero** ("2nd": display title **Heavy**, `heroHighlight(8.dp)`; `CompetitionText.ordinal`), with the segment score under it (mono caption Bold, TalkBack "Score 61.20");
    - a chevron.
  - **Tapping a row opens the result sheet** (`CompetitionResultSheet`). The old expandable "stacked folder" and its row chips are gone. The result sheet is a `ModalBottomSheet` with `GradusSheetHeader` "Close" and a ⋯ menu "Unlink" (destructive → the existing `AlertDialog`). It holds:
    - **Hero card:** the competition name (display title, heading); "`event` · `segment` · `dates`"; then the placing (display largeTitle Heavy, `heroHighlight()`) with the score (mono title3 Bold).
    - **Elements card** (skating, when the protocol is stored): one row per element, each with:
      - the executed code (mono subheadline Bold, 104 dp, shrinks to 0.7);
      - a **`GOEBar`** (§8.6.7);
      - the score (mono, 44 dp).

      Rows are separated by dividers. A 1.5 dp `textPrimary` rule, then "ELEMENTS" and the elements total. Each row reads "3Lz, base 5.90, GOE plus 1.18, score 7.08".
    - **Components card:** per component, the name (104 dp), a capsule bar `textSecondary` on `textTertiary` 12% out of 10, and the value. Then a rule, "COMPONENTS" and the total. TalkBack: "Skating skills, 7.25 out of 10".
    - A manually entered result (club `manual`) shows its note in a card instead.
    - **Action, under the cards:**
      - when a plan exists, the secondary **"View plan"**;
      - otherwise the primary **"Build a plan from this"** (sparkles; spinner while generating; `competition.generatePlan`), which on success closes the sheet and opens the plan.

      Generate needs AI permission, as before.
  - Data and the unlink rules are as before. Data (`CompetitionResultsModel.athleteResults`) is **cache-or-network**, not cache-then-network:
    - a per-athlete **in-memory** cache (not persisted): when an entry exists and `forceRefresh` is false, the cached list is returned with **no fetch**;
    - `forceRefresh = true` after a link; generate-plan clears that athlete's entry;
    - a per-athlete request sequence number discards stale replies, so an older slow fetch never overwrites a newer one. On a stale reply or an error, the cached list (else `[]`) is returned and the error is kept per athlete.
  - **Unlink:** `AlertDialog` `"Unlink this competition?"` / `"Removes the stored results. You can link it again later."` **Unlink** / **Keep it**.
  - **Enter results sheet** (`ManualResultSheet`; title "Results for `First`", "Close"). One card holds:
    - Competition (placeholder "e.g. Harbor City Open"), Date, Event or division ("e.g. U14 singles");
    - Result ("e.g. 2nd") and Score ("Optional") side by side;
    - Notes ("What went well, what to work on");
    - the outlined chip "Attach official results (PDF)". It uses `OpenDocument("application/pdf")`, **never photos**, and once attached shows a pen check + the file name (TalkBack "Attached {name}. Replace").

    The primary "Save results" sits under the card, disabled until there is a competition and a result. **iOS does not save it** (`ManualResultSheet` dismisses; no endpoint), so Android hides "Enter results" until the API exists (§12 N96).
- **Linking sheet** (`CompetitionLinkingSheet.swift`; full-screen dialog titled `"Link <athlete>"`, "Close" at the top start (`ad1e9bf`); Back when the competition was picked here): step 1 lists finished competitions (`"<dates> · <location>"`; `"No finished competitions yet."`; `"Couldn't load competitions"` + Try again); step 2 candidate skaters by name similarity (`club` or `"N event(s)"`; **`Likely match`** tag when `score ≥ 0.9`, tennis pen; `"No likely matches found for <athlete> at this event."`; `"Couldn't load matches"` + Try again); tapping a candidate links (files = its events' files), toasts `"Linked to <name>"`, closes.
- **Post-event card** (`PostEventCard.swift`) on the Roster tab after the wrap-up banner, one per `GET /coach/post-event` item, refreshed on Roster appear and app foreground (silent on failure); pill with trophy disc `"<competition> just finished"` / `LINK YOUR ATHLETES`; loads the competition roster on appear. Tap opens the **post-event sheet**: title = competition, Close, a top-app-bar text action **No one competed** → `AlertDialog` `"No one from your roster competed?"` / `"This card goes away and the results are not linked to any athlete."` **Dismiss this competition** (destructive) / Cancel → optimistic removal; on failure restore only that item if a refresh hasn't replaced it, and show the error. Sections: **Ready for a plan** (linked athletes with their summary, e.g. `"Short program 4th · Free skate 2nd"`, and **Generate plan** → open plan and close) and **Link an athlete** (unlinked roster rows with chevrons → linking sheet with the competition preselected; `"Every rostered figure skater is already linked."`; `"Couldn't load the roster"` + Try again).
- Tests: port `CompetitionResultsModelTests.swift` (post-event load, optimistic dismiss, failed dismiss restores, cached results returned without a fetch, forceRefresh, link refreshes cache, unlink removes, generate drops cache).

#### 7.10.3 Recaps (parent and athlete)

Endpoints: `GET /recaps/pending` (nullable `{competitionId, competitionName, datesLabel, athleteId?, athleteChoices[]}`), `POST /recaps/{id}/dismiss`, `GET /recaps/coaches?athleteId=`, `POST /recaps {competitionId, athleteId, body, coachIds?}` with an `Idempotency-Key`, `GET /athletes/{id}/recaps`. Online-only (`RecapModel.swift`). The recap posts into the athlete's existing coach threads server-side; Messages realtime (§6.6) shows it with no extra client work.

- **Recap prompt banner** on the Plans tab (parent/athlete home) under the page title (`RecapPromptBanner.swift`); checked on Plans appear and app foreground: pill with speech-bubble disc `"How did <competition> go?"` / `TAP TO SHARE A RECAP` (test tag `plans.recapBanner`) and an X ("Dismiss") → optimistic dismiss; on failure restore unless a newer pending prompt arrived, and surface the error.
- **Recap sheet** (`RecapSheet.swift`, full-screen dialog titled with the competition, "Close" at the top start): if `athleteId` is null, `WHO WAS THIS FOR?` with one button per athlete choice; then `"How did it go?"` (display), a multi-line editor (min ~140 dp, accent border when focused), **`SEND TO`** coach chips (all selected by default after `GET /recaps/coaches`), error line, **Send recap** (disabled when the text is blank or sending; tag `recap.send`). `coachIds` is sent as **null when all or none are selected** (iOS behavior; null = every rostered coach), else the selected ids. Success: toast `"Recap sent"`, clear the matching pending prompt, drop that athlete's cached recap list, close.
- **Recap screen** for route `recaps/{competitionId}` (push `gradus.route`, `gradus://recaps/<id>`; `RecapScreen.swift`): shows the sheet content only when it matches the current pending prompt (refreshing it if none is held); otherwise `"Nothing to recap here"` / `"This link's recap prompt isn't open for you right now."`; spinner until checked. Route lives on the Plans tab (`AppRoute.recap` → `.plans`), requires a session.
- `GET /athletes/{id}/recaps` is implemented in the repository and model (cache per athlete, de-duplicated in-flight loads) but **no iOS 1.0 screen shows it**; Android matches (data layer only).
- Tests: port `RecapModelTests.swift` (load, nil, optimistic dismiss, failed dismiss restores, submit clears prompt and cache, submit failure keeps prompt).

| Route | Source | Android |
|---|---|---|
| `board`, `board/<slug>` | App Links `https://gradus.training/board[/<slug>]`, `gradus://board/<slug>`, notification taps | Live graph; public (no session). |

### 7.11 Billing and invoicing

| Feature | Web today | iOS 1.0 (reference) | Android requirement | Pri |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Plan status | Tier, trial, Founding Coach, card-needed nudge, past-due banner | Display only (§6.8), neutral banners | Same `PlanCopy` logic and strings; Material 3 card. | P0 |
| Choose / change plan, add card, billing portal | Embedded Stripe checkout and portal | Web only; US link | Web only; US link under §6.8 gating (direct link, no enrollment; on in 1.0 behind the kill switch, A37). | P0 (link) |
| Claim / restore Founding Coach | Free action | Native | Native, same copy and confirmation. | P1 |
| Athlete rates and invoices | Rate, draft from lessons, preview, create, mark paid, delete, share | Native; share sheet | Native; Android share sheet. | P1 |

**Plan status (coach): Settings → Plan** (iOS `CoachPlanView.swift`, `PlanCopy.swift`, `AccountModel.coachBilling()`).

Data: `GET /api/v1/coach/billing` → `CoachBilling {entitlement (pending | club_covered | paid | promo_free), effectiveTier (coach | coach_pro | club), subscriptionTier?, subscriptionStatus?, trialEndsAt?, currentPeriodEnd?, hasStripeCustomer, foundingCoach, foundingProTrialUsed, freeAccessUntil?, trialNeedsCard, billingPastDue, athleteLimit? (null = unlimited), athleteCount, organizationName?, promoLabel?, promoPercentOff, manageUrl}`. Coaches only (the model no-ops for other roles). Flags from `GET /meta/config`: `paywallEnabled`, `foundingCoachCutoff` (default 2026-11-01T00:00:00Z) → `PlanGate`. Until `/meta/config` succeeds at launch, `PlanGate = (paywallEnabled = false, foundingCutoff = 2026-11-01T00:00:00Z)` (iOS `AppModel` starts with `PlanGate()` and replaces it only after a successful fetch). An unparseable `foundingCoachCutoff` becomes `Instant.MIN` (window closed), matching iOS `MetaConfigRepository` (`ISODate.parse(...) ?? .distantPast`). iOS does not cache the config between launches; Android does not either (a fetch failure keeps the default gate for that launch). `coachProEnabled` and `termsVersion` are decoded; `coachProEnabled` is unused in 1.0, as on iOS.

`PlanCopy.make(billing, gate, now)` is a pure Kotlin function in `core` with a 1:1 port of iOS `PlanCopyTests`. Rules, in order:
1. `rosterLine` = `"{athleteCount} of {athleteLimit} athletes"`, or `"Unlimited athletes"` when the limit is null.
2. `banner`: `billingPastDue` → "Payment failed — update your card on the web."; else `trialNeedsCard` → "Add a payment method on the web to keep your plan after the trial."; else none.
3. `foundingAction`: not founding → none; `entitlement == pending` → **claim**; `entitlement == paid && subscriptionTier == "coach_pro"` → **restore**; otherwise none.
4. Club-covered: title = `organizationName ?? "Club plan"`, subtitle "Club plan · your club covers your subscription.", pill "Club" (accent), **no manage URL** (no manage line at all).
5. Paid with a tier (checked before Founding, so a Founding Coach on Pro sees the paid plan): title "Coach" / "Coach Pro" / "Club" (`tierLabel`; unknown → "Coach"). Subtitle: `subscriptionStatus == "trialing"` with a trial end → "Free trial — ends {date}."; else if `billingPastDue` (the **boolean field**, not `subscriptionStatus == "past_due"`) → "Payment failed — update your card on the web."; else `status == "canceled"` with period end → "Ends {date}."; else `status == "active"` with period end → "Renews {date}.". Pill: founding && tier == coach_pro → "Founding · Pro" (accent); else trialing → "Trial" (accent); else `billingPastDue` → "Payment failed" (destructive); else canceled → "Canceling" (muted); else active → "Active" (accent); else none. The paid and club-covered copies (rules 4 and 5) still carry `banner` (rule 2) and `foundingAction` (rule 3); `manageURL` = `manageUrl` parsed as a URL (null when it does not parse).
6. Founding Coach (not paid): title "Founding Coach"; subtitle "Free access until {date}." when `freeAccessUntil` parses, else "Free for life — thank you for being here early."; pill "Coach · Free" (accent).
7. `promo_free`: with a date → title "Free access", subtitle "Free access until {date}.", pill "Free until {date}"; without → title "Complimentary access", subtitle "Your account is on the house — no card required.", pill "Free".
8. Otherwise title "No plan yet", no pill; subtitle "Finish setting up your plan on the web." when `paywallEnabled && now >= foundingCutoff`, else "Nothing to set up yet — your account is fully open."

Dates (`PlanCopy.shortDate`): parse ISO-8601 instant, or a date-only string by appending `T00:00:00Z`; format `MMM d, yyyy` in **`Locale.US`** in the **device time zone** (e.g. "Sep 8, 2026"); unparseable → null (line omitted). Matches the web's `toLocaleDateString`; a date-only value can therefore render one day earlier in US zones, exactly as on iOS; do not "fix" it on one platform only.

Screen (top bar title "Plan", back arrow; content max width 640 dp on wide screens per §8):
- **Plan card**: title (display font, title2), pill on the trailing side (tone → tag pen: destructive = pink, muted = iris, accent = tennis), subtitle, divider, people icon + roster line (mono). Test tags `plan.title`, `plan.pill`, `plan.subtitle`, `plan.roster`.
- **Banner** (if any): warning icon + text on the attention-wash surface, `plan.banner`.
- **Founding action**: claim → primary button "Activate my free Founding Coach plan" (`plan.foundingClaim`); restore → secondary button "Switch to free Coach" (`plan.foundingRestore`) opening an `AlertDialog` titled "Switch to your free Founding Coach plan?", text "Coach Pro ends now — no refund for the current period — and your roster limit returns to 5. Your one-time Pro trial is not restored.", confirm "Switch to free Coach" (error color), dismiss "Cancel". Both buttons disabled while busy.
- Action error line under them.
- **Manage line** when `manageUrl` present: link button or text per §6.8.
- Loading: card with "Loading your plan…". Error with nothing loaded: card with the error and chip "Try again" (`plan.retry`). Pull to refresh (`PullToRefreshBox`) reloads.

Founding writes (iOS `AccountModel.claimFoundingTier`/`restoreFoundingTier`): `POST /api/v1/coach/founding/claim` and `POST /api/v1/coach/founding/restore`, each with a fresh `Idempotency-Key`, **online-only** (offline → toast/error "You're offline. Try again when you're back online.", no request, never queued, never auto-retried). Success toasts: "Founding Coach plan activated" / "Switched to your free Founding Coach plan."; then refetch `/coach/billing` and refresh the shell's coach profile (so anything keyed on `profile.entitlement` updates). Server 409 copy shown verbatim (from `FoundingTierPreviewRulesTests`): `not_founding_coach` "This account isn't a founding coach."; `nothing_to_restore` "Nothing to switch — you're already on the free Founding Coach plan."; `club_covered` "You're on a club plan. Leave the club before switching tiers." No price, no "upgrade", no purchase wording in any of these strings (test).

**Plan status after onboarding** (iOS `FeatureOnboarding/PlanStatusView.swift`, §6.8 rule 6). `PlanGate.needsPlanSetup(profile)` = `paywallEnabled && now >= foundingCutoff && !entitlement.unlocksCoachArea` (`unlocksCoachArea` = entitlement != pending). It is **evaluated once**, when coach onboarding completes on this device (iOS `AppModel.onboardingFinished`, which sets `planSetupProfile`); it is **not** re-evaluated on later launches. If true, the shell presents the full-screen plan-status destination above the tabs (iOS `RootView`). "Continue" clears it for good. While it is up, a founding claim or restore from Settings re-fetches `GET /coach/profile` and replaces its profile (iOS `AppModel.refreshCoachProfile`). Sign-out clears it (teardown list, §7.12). Full-screen state: card icon, title "Finish setting up your plan", message (link shown) "Choose your plan at gradus.training, then come back here. Your roster and plans are waiting." or (no link) "Finish setting up your plan on the web. Your roster and plans are waiting."; primary "Manage your plan at gradus.training" (link case only, `/coach/paywall`; accessibility hint "Opens in your browser", iOS "Opens in Safari"); secondary "Continue" (`plan.continue`), which dismisses and never blocks the app. The founding-claim button on this screen exists in iOS code but is **not wired at HEAD** (`RootView` passes no `onClaimFounding`, so it never shows); Android matches HEAD (hidden) and §12 N40 asks Mariah whether both platforms should wire it.

**Team plan (parent): Settings → Team plan** (iOS `TeamPlanView.swift`; the guardians section beneath it is §7.7). `GET /api/v1/parent/team` → `TeamPlanStatus {active, status?, currentPeriodEnd?, hasBillingAccount, manageUrl}`. Page title "Team plan". Card: "Team plan" + status pill + description + renewal line (mono):

| Condition | Pill (tone) | Description | Renewal line |
|---|---|---|---|
| `!active` | Inactive (muted) | One parent or guardian per athlete. | none |
| `past_due` | Past due (destructive) | Payment failed. Update your payment method to keep your plan. | Current period ends {date} |
| `canceled` | Canceled (muted) | Your plan is ending. | Access ends {date} |
| `trialing` | Trial (attention) | Up to 3 parents or guardians per athlete. | Trial ends {date} |
| otherwise | Active (accent) | Up to 3 parents or guardians per athlete. | Renews {date} |

Card title "Team plan" in the display font (title3). Renewal dates (iOS `ParentSettingsText.shortDate`, which differs from `PlanCopy.shortDate`): `DateTimeFormatter.ofLocalizedDate(FormatStyle.MEDIUM)` in the **device locale** (not forced to en_US); an ISO instant is converted to the device zone, a date-only string is parsed as a `LocalDate` (no UTC shift, iOS `Birthdate.date(fromISO:)`). Below the card: the manage link as a **filled primary button** (iOS `.gradusPrimary`; the coach Plan screen's is secondary) when the §6.8 gate passes **and** `manageUrl` parses as a URL; otherwise the text line "Manage your team plan on the web." (§6.8). After the "I have an invite code" sheet (§7.7) succeeds: reload guardians, `/parent/team`, parent settings, then `/me` and celebrations (iOS `onLinksChanged`). States: "Checking your plan…" placeholder; error state "Couldn't load your plan" + "Try again". Pull to refresh reloads the plan and guardians. The Settings root row value reads the guardian list's `planActive` (co-guardian coverage) when loaded, else `/parent/team.active`: "Active" / "Not active".

**Invoicing (coach)** (iOS `Packages/FeatureInvoicing/**`, `GradusCore/Invoicing/*`; web `invoice-generate-sheet.tsx`, `athlete-billing-section.tsx`, `billing-tab.tsx`, `src/lib/invoice-format.ts`). Coach-only; no parent or athlete invoicing surface exists anywhere (parents learn of an invoice through the shared text).

*Endpoints* (all `/api/v1`): `PUT /coach/athletes/{id}/rate {rateKind: per_session|hourly, rateCents}`; `GET /coach/invoices?limit&cursor` (newest first, `{items, nextCursor}`); `GET /coach/athletes/{id}/billing` (rate + up to 200 invoices, not paginated); `GET /coach/invoices/{id}` (detail + `lines[{occurrenceDate, amountCents}]`); `POST /coach/invoices/preview {athleteId, periodStart?, periodEnd?}` → `{athleteId, athleteName, rate?, suggestedPeriodStart?, periodStart, periodEnd, lines[{slotId, occurrenceDate, startMinute, endMinute, amountCents, state: confirmed|scheduled|did_not_happen|canceled, defaultIncluded}]}`; `POST /coach/invoices` `[idem]` `{athleteId, periodStart, periodEnd, lines[{slotId?, occurrenceDate, startMinute?, endMinute?, amountCents, includedReason: "completed"}]}` → `{invoiceId, totalCents, lineCount}`; `PATCH /coach/invoices/{id}/status {status}`; `DELETE /coach/invoices/{id}` (422 "Paid invoices can't be deleted." when paid). Unknown enum values decode to safe defaults (`per_session`, `unpaid`, `confirmed`), as iOS does.

*Online-only, no outbox* (iOS `InvoicingModel` doc; handoff-I12 "money-critical writes are online-only"). The four writes check connectivity first and refuse without a request: "You're offline. Setting a rate needs a connection." / "You're offline. Creating an invoice needs a connection." / "You're offline. Updating an invoice needs a connection." / "You're offline. Deleting an invoice needs a connection." (error toast + inline). No Room cache for invoices: the global list always hits the network ("a stale balance is worse than a brief spinner"); per-athlete billing is cached **in memory for the session** (cache-then-network, `forceRefresh` on pull-to-refresh and after the generate sheet closes). Android does not persist invoices in Room or WorkManager (Appendix B: "not cached").

*No entitlement gate* (iOS #156, `d16f40a`, 2026-10-16). Every coach plan has included invoicing since 2026-09-12 (Mariah), and the server never checked a tier. iOS removed `InvoicingEntitlementGate`, its locked note ("Coach Pro or Club unlocks invoicing."), the plan fetch that fed it, and their tests, because "plan not loaded yet" read as locked and flashed the note (and stayed locked for the session if the fetch failed). Android builds **no gate**: the invoicing sections, the Bill buttons and the athlete card's billing section render as soon as their own data loads, with no `GET /coach/billing` dependency and no link-out.

*Roster → Invoicing segment* (`BillingRosterSection.swift` at `c8f83d6`; the segment label is **"Invoicing"** since iOS #117 / web #205, raw value `billing`). It excludes the client-side sample/demo athlete (`SampleAthlete.isSample`). Top to bottom (handoff §7 Invoicing):
- **Hero:**
  - the **collected total**: the sum of paid invoices, in display largeTitle **Heavy**, tabular, on the stripe (`heroHighlight()`);
  - then "collected of **$X**" (subheadline `textSecondary`), where X = paid + sent + still to bill;
  - then **one bar**, 10 dp, capsule, on a `textTertiary` 15% track: paid as a solid `accent` segment, sent as `accent` at 35%, and still to bill as the empty track.

  The hero is one TalkBack node: "Collected $420 of $980. $140 sent, $420 still to bill." (`billing.collected`).
- **The three totals ARE the filter**: **To bill · Sent · Paid**, in one row on a `textTertiary` 8% rounded tray (padding 4). Each total is a button:
  - an uppercase caption2 Bold label (`textPrimary` when chosen, else `textSecondary`) over its amount (display title2, tabular, shrinking to 0.7 on one line);
  - **the chosen one** sits on a `card` fill and gets the **loose pen underline**: `PenMarkView(Underline)` in `accent`, line 4, **roughness 1.6**, seed = label length + 7; 8 dp tall, inset 10 dp, 2 dp from the bottom;
  - TalkBack "To bill, $420" with `selected`; ids `billing.filter.toBill|sent|paid`.

  The To bill total shows **"—"** until every athlete's draft is in (TalkBack "still checking").
- **Lists:** plain lists in **one** borderless card. Every row has the same height (min 52 dp, padding 14 × 10): the title (body Bold, 2 lines) over a detail line (subheadline `textSecondary`), the amount (body Bold, tabular), then the row's action. Row actions are **verbs, as outlined chips. There are no symbols in invoicing.**
  - **To bill** (default): each athlete with lessons to bill, or not yet known.
    - Detail: "`N` lesson(s)", or "`N` lessons · no rate yet" with no amount; "Checking…" while that athlete's draft loads; "Couldn't check" on failure. **Never "$0" or settled while unknown.**
    - Action: the chip **"Bill"**, which opens the Bill sheet. TalkBack: "Bill {name}, 3 lessons, $210", or "…, no rate yet". Tag `billing.invoiceAthlete.{id}`.
    - Empty: "Nothing to bill.".
  - **Sent:** unpaid invoices. Title = the athlete, detail "`Sep 1 – Sep 30` · sent `Oct 2`", the amount, and the chip **"Mark paid"** (TalkBack "Mark {name}'s $140 invoice paid"; disabled while any status write runs; tag `billing.markPaid.{id}`). Tapping the row opens the invoice. Empty: "Nothing waiting on payment.".
  - **Paid:** the same rows with no action. Empty: "Nothing paid yet.".
  - Rows are sorted with settled athletes last, then by outstanding amount, largest first.
- **To bill data** (`101953d`, iOS #147, `InvoicingModel.loadToBill`, `ToBill`): each athlete's To bill is **exactly the draft the Bill sheet would open with**, from `POST /coach/invoices/preview {athleteId}` with no period. Nothing is saved.
  - `lessons` = the count of lines with `defaultIncluded`; `cents` = the sum of their `amountCents`; `hasRate = rate != null`.
  - **Loading:** the drafts load when the Invoicing segment appears, for every roster athlete except the sample, **at most 4 in flight**. A value under **60 s** old is reused unless forced. A per-athlete generation number drops a result that arrives out of order.
  - **Forced reloads:** after an invoice is created, after an invoice is deleted (find the athlete in the invoice list or in the per-athlete billing), and whenever the Bill sheet's default-window preview returns, so a rate just set shows at once. Lessons on an invoice drop out of the next draft, so To bill falls when an invoice is created.
  - **Failure** keeps the last value; with none, the athlete is marked failed ("Couldn't check").
  - Online only; held in the invoicing ViewModel for the session.
- **Invoices:** the global list (`GET /coach/invoices`, all pages: Sent and Paid need every invoice, so the list loads `nextCursor` pages until done) drives Sent, Paid and the totals. First load only once per session (`hasLoadedInvoicesOnce`).
  - **All invoices sheet** ("All invoices", "Done"): the full history as rows, each with:
    - athlete name;
    - date range;
    - a pen mark: a **check** (`penTennisInk`, seed 5) when paid, the **envelope** (`borderStrong`, seed 9) when sent; TalkBack "Paid" / "Sent, not paid yet";
    - the total.

    Rows use infinite scroll (port `shouldLoadMore` and its 5 tests), and keep the Android load-more retry row (§12 N69).

*Athlete detail → Invoicing section* (`AthleteBillingSection.swift` at `c8f83d6`; embedded in the coach's athlete detail, §7.2; hidden for the sample athlete).
- **Header:** "INVOICING" (mono caption, uppercase via the text style, a heading for TalkBack) and the outlined chip **"Bill"** (`billing.generateInvoice`; it was "Generate invoice"), always shown (no gate, iOS #156).
- **Rate line** (`AthleteBillingFormatting.rateLine`): "No rate set yet", or "{formatShort} per session" / "{formatShort} per hour" (e.g. "$70 per session", "$62.50 per hour").
- **Invoice rows** (one borderless card), the same row as the roster list:
  - the date range (body Bold) over "`n` session(s) · sent `Oct 2`";
  - the amount;
  - then, while unpaid, the chip **"Mark paid"** (disabled while any status write is in flight); once paid, the word "**Paid**" in subheadline Bold `accentInk`.

  Tapping a row opens the invoice, where it can be resent or deleted. The raw-wire status tag, the Share chip and the per-row trash chip are **gone** (`ad1e9bf`).
- Status toggles are disabled while **any** status write is in flight (`isUpdatingStatus`); trash chips are disabled while **any** delete is in flight (`isDeletingInvoice`); same in Invoice detail. A successful rate save patches the athlete's cached billing `rate` in memory, so the rate line updates immediately (iOS `InvoicingModel.setRate`).
- Empty: dashed-outline box "No invoices yet."; loading: progress + "Loading invoicing…"; load error: the message text.
- After the generate sheet closes (any outcome), force-refresh this athlete's billing.

*Generate invoice sheet* (`InvoiceGenerateSheet.swift`, `RateEntrySection.swift`). Android presentation: a **full-screen dialog** (Material 3 full-screen dialog pattern) with a `GradusSheetHeader` whose start action is **"Close"**, because it holds a form with date pickers and a keyboard. The title is **"Bill {athleteName}"**, then "Invoice created" after success. Close stays. **Bill, Invoice created and an invoice share one shape** (handoff): one card pinned to the top, with the button under it. On open: **clear any previous draft first** (`InvoicingModel.clearDraft()`: draft and draft error to null), then `preview(athleteId, null, null)`, so the sheet shows the loading state and never another athlete's lines. (Intentional fix of an iOS rough edge: iOS `InvoiceGenerateSheet` renders the shared `model.draft` before its own preview returns and never calls `clearDraft()`, so opening the sheet for athlete B briefly shows athlete A's lines; §12 N69.)
- Loading → centered progress. Preview error with no draft → state "Couldn't build this invoice" + message + "Try again". Preview error from a **date change** while a draft is shown: keep the draft, show the error as an error line under the date fields plus an error toast, and keep the coach's chosen dates (iOS keeps the old draft and never shows the error, because its content switch checks the draft first; §12 N69).
- **No rate** (`draft.rate == null`) → rate entry card: "Set a rate for {firstName} to continue" (first word of the name); segmented button "Per session" | "Hourly" (`invoice.rateKind`, default per session); field "Amount (USD)" with placeholder "70", decimal keyboard (`KeyboardType.Decimal`, `invoice.rateAmount`); primary "Save rate" (spinner while saving, `invoice.saveRate`). Validation: `InvoiceMoney.parse` must yield > 0 cents, else "Enter a rate first". Success toast "Rate saved", then re-run the preview. The rate can only be set here when missing; there is no "change rate" screen (web parity).
- **Draft editor**: **one card** (borderless) holding, top to bottom: the "From" – "To" dates on one row; a divider; the lessons; a 1.5 dp `textPrimary` rule; then "TOTAL" (mono caption Bold) and the total (display title2). The **"Bill $X"** primary sits under the card (below). There is no intro sentence (`ad1e9bf`). "From" and "To" date fields (Material 3 `DatePickerDialog`; the value is a local calendar date `yyyy-MM-dd`; convert the picker's UTC millis with `ZoneOffset.UTC` to avoid an off-by-one) seeded from the response's `periodStart`/`periodEnd`; changing either re-runs the preview with both and **reseeds all line edits**. Lines: a **`PenCheckbox(Square, 24)`** (seed `n(occurrenceDate) + amountCents % 7`, §8.6.4; tap target ≥ 48 dp; TalkBack "Include {Sep 6}", selected state), short date (bold), state tag (Confirmed = tennis, Scheduled = pool, Didn't happen = orange, Canceled = pink), and an amount field (placeholder "0.00", trailing-aligned, decimal keyboard, dimmed when unchecked; TalkBack "Amount for {date}"). Edits seed from `defaultIncluded` and `amountCents` formatted as `InvoiceMoney.format` without "$". Empty window: "No un-billed lessons in these dates.". The create error is an `ErrorLine` under the card. The primary **"Bill $X"** (paper-plane icon; X = `InvoiceMoney.formatShort(total)`; the button names what happens) is enabled only when a rate exists, ≥ 1 line is included and no create is in flight. Test tag `invoice.create`.
- Totals (`InvoiceDraftCalculator`, pure, ported with its tests): a line counts only if its edit exists and is checked; its amount is the parsed edit, falling back to the line's own `amountCents` when the text does not parse; total = sum.
- **Create**: fresh `Idempotency-Key` per attempt; lines sent with `includedReason: "completed"`. Outcomes (`CreateInvoiceFailure`): 409 `idempotency_key_reused` → stale request (server message); 409 `idempotency_key_in_progress` → create in progress (server message); 422 `unprocessable` **with the exact message** "Those sessions have already been invoiced." → already invoiced; anything else → the API error's user message. All show as error toast + inline line; the draft stays editable. Success: toast "Invoice created", drop the athlete's cached billing, reload the invoice list, and replace the content with the **created view**. It is the **receipt** pinned to the top with **"Send"** under it, and nothing else: the "Send it over…" sentence, the mono text box and "Done" are gone (`ad1e9bf`). The receipt (`InvoiceReceipt`) is one borderless card:
- the athlete (display title2) and the period (mono footnote);
- one row per billed lesson: "`Sep 6` ····· `$70.00`" (mono, with a `divider` leader), then a **pen check** (`penTennisInk`, seed 30 + index). TalkBack: "Sep 6, $70.00, billed";
- a `textPrimary` divider, then "TOTAL" and the total in display largeTitle **on the hero stripe** (`heroHighlight()`).

The **"Sent"** stamp appears top-end **only after Send was tapped**: display title3 italic `penTennisInk`, **circled in pen** (`Circle`, seed 21), rotated −6°, TalkBack "Sent". The primary **"Send"** (share icon; `invoice.share`) opens the Android share sheet with the invoice text and marks it sent on this screen. Close dismisses.
- Back/predictive back while creating: ignored (no dismiss mid-request). **Android addition, not in iOS** (`InvoiceGenerateSheet` sets no `interactiveDismissDisabled`). Reason: a create is not idempotent across sheet instances (each attempt has a fresh key), so dismissing mid-request and reopening can produce a duplicate attempt against the same sessions. §12 N69; drop it if strict A2 parity is preferred.

*Invoice detail* (`InvoiceDetailView.swift`): full-screen dialog/sheet titled with the athlete name ("Invoice" until loaded), "Close" action. Loads `GET /coach/invoices/{id}` itself (no cache); "Loading invoice…"; error state "Couldn't load this invoice" + message (default "Something went wrong.") + "Try again". Content: the same **receipt** card as the created view (§E90 shape), with its stamp circled: "**Paid**" when paid, "**Sent**" otherwise. Under it "{range} · {n} lesson(s) · sent {Oct 2}" (caption). Then the actions:
- while unpaid, the one lime **"Mark paid"** (full width);
- once paid, the outlined chip **"Mark unpaid"**.

Status changes go through `setStatus`: the local copy updates only after the server succeeds, with the success toasts "Marked paid"/"Marked unpaid". Below them, the secondary button **"Resend"** (share icon; `invoiceDetail.share`) opens the share sheet. Only when unpaid, there is also a destructive trash chip (TalkBack "Delete invoice"; `invoiceDetail.delete`) → the same delete dialog. (The tappable status tag, the line card and "Share invoice" are replaced by the receipt and these actions; `ad1e9bf`.) delete success dismisses the sheet with toast "Invoice deleted". Status and delete changes also patch every cached list and athlete billing in memory.

*Formatting* (`InvoiceFormatting.swift`; must match web `src/lib/invoice-format.ts` byte for byte):
- `InvoiceMoney.format(cents)` → `"$X.XX"` with a literal dot, sign before "$", **never locale-formatted** (do not use `NumberFormat`).
- `formatShort(cents)` → "$70" when whole dollars, else `format`.
- `parse(input)` → keep only `0-9` and `.`; empty, unparseable (`toDoubleOrNull()`), non-finite or negative → null; else `round(value × 100)` half away from zero (`Math.round` is equivalent for non-negative values).
- `formatShortDate("yyyy-MM-dd")` → local calendar date formatted with the skeleton "MMMd" (`DateTimeFormatter.ofPattern(DateTimePatternGenerator…)` / `android.text.format.DateFormat.getBestDateTimePattern(locale, "MMMd")`), e.g. "Sep 6"; unparseable → the raw string.
- `formatDateRange` → "{start} – {end}" with an en dash (U+2013).
- `buildInvoiceText(athleteName, coachName?, periodStart, periodEnd, lines, totalCents)` → lines joined by `\n`: "Invoice — {athleteName}" (em dash U+2014), the range, "", one "{short date}  {amount}" per line (two spaces), "", "Total: {amount}", and "— {coachName}" only when given. Both iOS share points pass **no coach name**; Android does the same.
- Contract addition: add `Contract/vectors/invoice-format.json` (inputs and expected strings for `format`, `formatShort`, `parse`, `buildInvoiceText`) generated from the web function so iOS and Android test against one source.

*Share* (iOS `ShareLink`): `Intent.ACTION_SEND`, `type = "text/plain"`, `EXTRA_TEXT` = invoice text, `Intent.createChooser(intent, null)`. No PDF, no attachment, no file provider.

*Haptics, a11y*: iOS plays **no** haptic on invoice create (only the "Invoice created" toast), so Android plays none of its own here; if §7.13 defines a shared haptic for every success toast, that rule applies uniformly and nothing invoice-specific is added. Errors announced (live region polite). Test tags mirror iOS accessibility identifiers.

*Tests* (port of `FeatureInvoicingTests` + `GradusCoreTests/InvoicingTests`): pagination and cursor; cache-then-network and `forceRefresh`; offline refusals never reach the repository; create outcomes for the three coded races and generic errors (including a different 422 that must **not** map to already-invoiced); no gate (invoicing renders with no billing fetch); To bill from drafts (default-included lines only; no false $0 before a draft; "Couldn't check" after a failure; at most 4 drafts at once; 60 s reuse; out-of-order results dropped; reload after create, delete and the sheet's default preview; port `InvoicingModelTests` #147); draft calculator; rate line, session pluralization, toggle, unpaid-only delete; money and text formatting. Android additions: open the generate sheet for athlete A, cancel, open for athlete B, and assert A's lines never render; a failed date-change preview keeps the draft and shows the error line; a load-more failure shows the inline retry row; status/delete controls disabled while a write is in flight.

### 7.12 Settings and account

| Feature | Web today | iOS 1.0 (reference, code at 91c6af2) | Android requirement | Pri |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Profile | Name, email (coach: sports and levels) | Native; coach sports and levels native (#27) | Native, same. | P0 |
| Appearance | Light / Dark / System | Native, System default | Native, System default; Gradus tokens, no dynamic color. | P0 |
| Account & security | Change password, change email, delete account with impact | Native | Native. | P0 |
| Device | Push toggle + permission state; biometric lock | Native, plus Read-aloud voice (#47) | Native: notification permission + system-settings deep link, BiometricPrompt lock, TTS voice picker. | P0 |
| Blocked people | Blocked list | Native | Native. | P0 |
| Legal | Privacy, terms, licenses | Opens web pages; OSS licenses screen | Opens browser; OSS licenses screen. | P0 |
| Support / feedback | Feedback FAB, feedback list | "Send feedback" sheet; no floating button, no shake gesture (none in code) | "Send feedback" sheet; no FAB, no shake. | P0 |
| Sign out | | Native | Native. | P0 |
| Connections hub (coach) | Code, join club, coach visibility | Native (I14) | Native. | P1 |
| Pending changes (Sync Center) | Not on web | Removed 2026-09-12 (gradus-ios #28): no screen, no badge; outbox runs silently | Same: no screen, no badge, no deep link. (iOS docs/README.md and QA.md still mention it; the code wins.) | — |

**Settings root** (iOS `FeatureSettings/SettingsView.swift`). Material 3 screen, top app bar "Settings", a `LazyColumn` of grouped sections on the paper background, each group headed by an eyebrow label (uppercase, mono caption) and rows on the card surface. Row anatomy (`SettingsRow`): leading icon + title, optional count badge (accent capsule; TalkBack "{n} waiting"), optional trailing value (secondary text, up to 2 lines, middle-truncated), then a chevron for in-app navigation or an "open in new" arrow for external links (TalkBack hint "Opens in your browser"). Rows navigate through the shell's typed routes (`SettingsRoute.<Section>`) so a deep link to the Settings root pops them (§6.10). Load on entry: account credentials (email, providers); coach: name, `/coach/billing` if not loaded, coach-visibility model; parent: parent settings + team guardians; athlete: settings if not loaded. On `ON_RESUME`: refresh parent, athlete, team guardians and coach visibility models.

Section order and rows per role (exact titles; icons are the Material Symbols equivalents of the iOS SF Symbols):

| # | Section (eyebrow) | Coach | Parent | Athlete |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | **Profile** | "Name" (value "First Last"; opens Profile name sheet) · "Sports and levels" (pushes the editor). Footer: name-load error in destructive ink, else "Add more sports on Coach Pro or Club." | "Name" (value "First Last"; pushes Parent profile) | "Profile" (value full name; pushes Athlete profile) |
| 1b | **Verification** (parent only, when `showsVerification` and a step exists) | — | Inline compact KWS verification step (§6.13; decision #34) | — |
| 2 | **Coaching** | "Connections" (value = coach-visibility sub-label, badge = requests waiting) | — | "Coaches" (value = number of coaches) |
| 2b | **Family** | — | "My athletes" (value = count when > 0) · "Team plan" (value "Active"/"Not active") | — |
| 2c | **Safety** | — | — | "Safe Sport"; footer "Who to talk to if something at practice feels off. Independent of Gradus and your coach." |
| 3 | **Plan** | "Plan" (value = `PlanCopy.title`) | — | — |
| 4 | **Appearance** | segmented "System" / "Light" / "Dark" | same | same |
| 5 | **Account** | "Account & security" (value = email) · "Device" · "AI features" (value "On"/"Off"; only when `aiFeatures.offered`, §6.7.1a) · "Blocked people" | same | same (adult athletes only; never for under 18) |
| 6 | **Legal** | "Terms of Service" ↗ · "Privacy Policy" ↗ · "Open-source licenses" | same | same |
| 7 | **Support** | "Send feedback" | same | same |
| 8 | **Debug** (debug builds only) | "Simulate offline" switch; "API" base URL | same | same |
| 9 | (no header) | "Sign out" (destructive); footer "Gradus {versionName} ({versionCode}) · {Role}" | same | same |

Role footer: the role raw value with "_" → space, capitalized ("Coach", "Parent", "Athlete"); "No role yet" when unknown. Org admins get no role sections (web-only role, iOS #2). Coach "Sports and levels" falls back to an external row opening `https://gradus.training/coach/settings` (footer "Sports and levels are edited on the web for now.") only when the native source is unavailable; in the shipping graph it is always native.

**Profile name (coach)** (`ProfileNameView.swift`): modal bottom sheet (`ModalBottomSheet`, skip-partially-expanded false so it opens half then full), title "Name", "Cancel" / "Save" ("Saving…"). Fields "First name" (placeholder "First") and "Last name" ("Last") with autofill content types person-name-given / person-name-family; trimmed, max 80 chars each. Validation on Save: "First name is required." / "Last name is required.". Loads from `GET /coach/profile`, saves through `PUT /coach/profile` (`saveName`); online call, server error keeps the sheet open with its message; success: success haptic, toast "Name saved". Load failure → "Couldn't load your name." in the Profile footer.

**Parent profile** (`ParentProfileView.swift`): pushed screen, title "Profile", page heading "Your name", card text "How coaches and your athletes see you.", first/last fields, "Save" ("Saving…") enabled only when dirty, both non-empty and not saving. Save (iOS `ParentSettingsModel.updateProfile`/`optimistic`/`perform`): trim both names; either empty → inline error "Enter a first and last name."; a body-encode failure → "Couldn't save the change.". Apply the change to the shared parent settings model **optimistically**, so the Settings root "Name" value updates at once. Then `PATCH /parent/profile` with a fresh `Idempotency-Key`: live success → persist the cache and show the success toast "Name saved"; offline, transport error (status 0) or 5xx → queue the same method, path, body and key in the outbox (entity kind `settings`, label "Your name") with the plain toast "Saved — it syncs when you're back online." and drop the cached ETag (so the next fetch hits the network); an outbox enqueue failure → "Couldn't save the change."; a 4xx → its user message as the inline error and **roll back** the optimistic change. Fields seed once and only refill untouched fields on later loads. Loading placeholder "Loading…"; error "Couldn't load your profile" + "Try again".

**Athlete profile** (`Athlete/AthleteProfileView.swift`; detail of §7.8): title "Profile". Card "Name & birthdate" (first, last, birthdate field), "Save" (`PATCH /athlete/me`, queued offline), enabled when dirty and names non-empty. Fields re-seed from the model only when untouched or after a save. Save rules (iOS `AthleteSettingsModel.updateMe`): trim names and birthdate; either name empty → "First and last name are required."; a non-empty birthdate that is not a valid ISO date → "Enter a valid date of birth."; an empty birthdate is sent as `null` (clears it). Fresh `Idempotency-Key`; live success → toast "Saved" (success); offline, status 0 or 5xx → queued under the same key (entity kind `settings`, label "Your name"), plain toast "Saved — it syncs when you're back online."; 4xx → its message inline and as an error toast; enqueue failure → "Couldn't save the change.". After a live or queued save: update the cached athlete settings (first, last, birthdate) in the `athlete-settings.json` snapshot (§6.5), set the goals header name to "{first} {last}" (iOS `goals.athleteName`), and persist. Sign-in card "Sign-in: {username}" when a username exists; "Waiting for your parent" card with "Your goals and plans are yours now. Connecting a coach and messaging open once a parent or guardian confirms your account from the email we sent them. Accounts nobody confirms are removed after three months." for provisional accounts (#31).
- **"Your account is paused" card** (account state `paused`): eyebrow "Your account is paused" plus a **client constant**, not a server string (iOS `GradusCore/Onboarding/ConsentModels.swift` `AthleteAccountState.pausedMessageForAthlete`), chosen by the pause's source, never by the device: §6.13 B4 owns the copy and the optional server field `pausedVia` (`app_store` → the iOS sentence verbatim, "A parent or guardian withdrew consent for Gradus through Apple, so messaging and connecting with coaches are off for now. Your goals and plans are still here. Questions: support@gradussports.com."; `google_play` → the Google Play variant; missing or unknown → the generic sentence; S-11; §12 N71). The parent-side counterpart (iOS `pausedMessageForParent(firstName:)`, shown on the parent's athlete detail, §7.7.5) follows the same rule.
- **Guardian card**: the editable FeatureGuardians card (§7.7) for a minor whose guardian has not joined; otherwise the read-only "Parent or guardian" row (iOS `AthleteSettingsModel.guardian`): guardian claimed → value "On Gradus", detail = guardian email; hidden when not a minor (`guardianRequired` = no birthdate or a minor birthdate); no guardian email → "Needed" / "Because you're under 18, we keep a parent or guardian email on file and send them a link to follow along."; email with a parseable `guardianInvitedAt` → {email} / "Invited {MMM d, yyyy}" (device-locale medium date); email without one → {email} / the same note.
- Tests: port `AthleteSettingsTests` (updateMeTrimsAndSavesLive, updateMeRequiresBothNames, invalid birthdate, offline queue, 5xx queue, guardian row cases) and the parent profile equivalents (validation, optimistic apply, live toast, offline/5xx queue, 4xx rollback). States: "Couldn't load your profile" / "Loading your profile…" / "No athlete profile found.". Pull to refresh; refresh on resume.

**Sports and levels (coach; decision #27)** (`Profile/CoachSportsView.swift`). Pushed screen "Sports and levels". Data `GET /coach/profile` (`profile` + `levels[{sport, levelKey, hoursPerWeek}]`); catalog from the vendored `Contract/vectors/coach-sports.json` (`SportCatalog`; `strength_conditioning` is always secondary). Primary-sport cap (`CoachSports.maxPrimarySports`): `effectiveTier != coach` → unlimited; Founding Coach already holding > 1 distinct primary sport → unlimited (grandfathered); else 1.
- Intro (eyebrow "Sports you coach"): "Tap a sport to add or remove it. Each sport's levels carry the practice hours per week you expect; they set every athlete's target band."
- Card: flow row of sport chips (secondary sports sorted first), selected chips show a check; a chip that would exceed the cap is disabled at 45% opacity (TalkBack "{Sport}, not available on your plan"). Existing custom sports show as removable chips (✕, "Remove {Sport}").
- Cap message when at the cap: "Your plan includes {n} primary sport(s) plus Strength & Conditioning. Choose Coach Pro for more sports." plus, **only when the §6.8 link gate passes**, the link "Choose Coach Pro on gradus.training" (opens `/coach/settings` signed in). iOS shows that link on every storefront; Android applies the US gate (see §6.8 table) and §12 N61 asks whether iOS should match.
- "Don't see your sport? Request it" → sheet "Request a sport": "Tell us which sport you coach and we'll look at adding it. Pick the closest listed sport for now.", field "Which sport?" (placeholder "Pickleball", words capitalization, max 80), "Cancel" / "Send" ("Sending…"), keyboard action Send. A name matching a listed sport selects it instead (or shows "{Sport} is already listed. {cap message}" when the cap blocks it). Otherwise `POST /api/v1/sport-requests`; confirmation "Thanks. We'll look at adding {sport}. Pick the closest listed sport for now; you can change it later in Settings." with "Done"; error default "Couldn't send that. Try again.". Announce "Request sent".
- For each selected sport with catalog levels: eyebrow with the sport label, card listing levels (label, optional hint) with an hours field (decimal, accepts "," as decimal separator, 0–80, invalid input ignored; displays integers without decimals, else one decimal) and "hr/wk". Newly added sports seed each level's `suggestedHours`.
- "Save" ("Saving…" with spinner), enabled when dirty, ≥ 1 sport and ready; sends every level of every selected sport (`PUT /api/v1/coach/levels`, `putCoachLevels`), toast "Sports and levels saved", then reloads. Load error state "Couldn't load your sports" + "Try again"; loading "Loading your sports…". Online-only.
- States (iOS `CoachSportsModel.Phase` loading/ready/saving/failed): sport chips are disabled while loading or saving (`isBusy`). A level with no stored hours shows the catalog default (`catalog.defaultSuggestedHours`). **Save failure**: keep the form and the edits, show the error line above Save as an assertive live region (iOS `ErrorLine(announces: true)`); Save stays disabled (`canSave` requires phase ready) until pull-to-refresh or re-entry reloads, exactly as iOS. Whether Android should instead re-enable Save after a failure is §12 N70 (parity default: same as iOS).
- In "Request a sport": "Send" is disabled while the trimmed name is empty (empty is a no-op); a name matching a listed sport selects it and closes the sheet, unless the cap refuses it, in which case the sheet stays open with "{Sport} is already listed. {cap message}" (gradus-ios `FeatureOnboarding/Components/RequestSport.swift`).
- The model must be owned by the destination's `ViewModel` (Hilt `@HiltViewModel` scoped to the nav entry), not recreated per recomposition (iOS handoff-testflight lesson: the screen spun forever when the model lived in the destination closure).

**Appearance** (`GradusDesign/Appearance.swift`): `System` (default) / `Light` / `Dark`, Material 3 `SingleChoiceSegmentedButtonRow`, stored per device in DataStore (`gradus.appearance`), survives sign-out (iOS `@AppStorage`). Applied as follows. API 31+: `UiModeManager.setApplicationNightMode(MODE_NIGHT_AUTO|NO|YES)`, so the splash screen and system UI match. All API levels: the root `GradusTheme(darkTheme = …)` reads the DataStore value (System → `isSystemInDarkTheme()`), and system bars are set with `enableEdgeToEdge(SystemBarStyle.auto/light/dark)` to match the chosen mode. API 29–30: the splash uses the `core-splashscreen` theme with day/night resources; `AppCompatDelegate.setDefaultNightMode` has no effect on a Compose `ComponentActivity` and is called only if an `AppCompatActivity` is ever introduced. Read the preference **synchronously at startup** (before `setContent`, e.g. a blocking first read of the DataStore value cached in memory) so there is no light/dark flash. Gradus color tokens only; Material You dynamic color is never used (§8).

**Account & security** (`Account/AccountSecurityView.swift`, `AccountModel.swift`). Pushed screen "Account & security".
- Group "Sign-in": "Email" row (value or "None on file", middle-truncated); "Change email" (disabled with no email); "Change password". Footer when no email: "Your account signs in with a username, so there is no email to change."
- Session source (iOS `GradusAPI/SupabaseSessionManager.swift` `AccountCredentials`; iOS PRD §6.4): **supabase-kt Auth (gotrue-kt) is a dependency**, not only Realtime and Storage. It holds the session the auth broker returns (§6.4), and Settings uses it for four things: the current session's email, the providers list, `updateUser(email)` and `updateUser(password)`. Auth failures map to `APIError(code = "auth_update_failed", status = 400, message = the Auth error description)`. §6.3/§6.4, the stack line ("Auth + Realtime + Storage") and Appendix G must say the same.
- Group: "Signed in with" + provider chips. Providers (iOS `providers()`): `app_metadata.providers` (string array) if non-empty, else `[app_metadata.provider]` if present, else `identities[].provider`. Labels (iOS `AccountModel.providerLabels`): lowercase, dedupe in first-seen order, `email` → "Email", `apple` → "Apple", `google` → "Google", other → capitalized ("Loading…" until read). Chip icons (iOS `providerSymbol`): Apple logo for Apple, globe for Google, envelope for Email, none otherwise. Port the test "Providers become chip labels, deduplicated and in order". Footer "Sign in with Apple and Google are linked to this account by email." (verbatim; true on Android too, since Apple sign-in uses the web flow, A5).
- Group: destructive "Delete account"; footer "Permanently delete your account and personal data."
- **Change email** sheet (full-height bottom sheet), title "Change email", text "We'll send a confirmation to both your current and new address. The change takes effect once both are confirmed.", "Current email" (read-only), "New email", "Confirm new email" (placeholder "you@example.com", email keyboard, no autocapitalization or autocorrect). Validation (`emailProblem`): must contain "@" and "." and no space → "Enter a valid email."; case-insensitive mismatch → "The emails don't match."; same as current → "That's the same as your current email.". Confirm button "Send confirmation" ("Sending…"). Validation runs on the trimmed text (iOS `emailProblem` trims and compares case-insensitively), and the new email is **trimmed and lowercased** before `auth.updateUser(email)` through supabase-kt Auth (iOS `AccountModel.changeEmail`), online-only. Success: toast "Check both inboxes to confirm the change." and the sheet dismisses. Errors show inline (the sheet stays open) and as an error toast.
- **Change password** sheet, title "Change password": "New password" (placeholder "At least 8 characters"), "Confirm new password" ("Type it again"), autofill new-password hints. Validation: < 8 → "Use at least 8 characters."; mismatch → "The passwords don't match.". "Save" ("Saving…") → `auth.updateUser(password)`, online-only, toast "Password updated". Below a divider: chip "Forgot it? Email me a reset link" → "Reset link sent" (disabled after sending or with no email) → `POST /auth/recover {email}`; toast "Reset link sent to {email}."; no email → error "We couldn't find your email address.". Note text: no email → "Your account signs in with a username. Ask your parent or coach to reset your password."; else, with the native-reset flag on, "The link opens Gradus so you can set a new password." and off "The link opens the Gradus website, where you set a new password. Then sign in here again." (iOS reads `GRADUS_NATIVE_RESET`, which gradus-ios `project.yml` sets **true** at HEAD; Android's `BuildConfig.GRADUS_NATIVE_RESET` is `true` (§9.6), so the first sentence shows, and the reset link reaches the app via App Links, §6.10).
